## Reviewer's Guide Integrates the electron-liquid-glass native module for macOS Tahoe and centralizes all platform-specific window visual effects in WindowThemeManager, which now owns creation-time config and runtime updates for Windows and macOS, while Browser and app/window configs stop passing vibrancy/visual effect options directly. #### Sequence diagram for Browser window creation with macOS Tahoe liquid glass ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant Browser participant WindowThemeManager participant BrowserWindow participant WebContents participant liquidGlassModule User->>Browser: openWindow(identifier) Browser->>Browser: createBrowserWindow() Browser->>WindowThemeManager: getPlatformConfig() Note over WindowThemeManager: isMacTahoe true and liquidGlass available WindowThemeManager-->>Browser: {transparent true, trafficLightPosition} Browser->>BrowserWindow: new BrowserWindow(baseOptions + platformConfig) Browser->>WindowThemeManager: attach(browserWindow) WindowThemeManager->>WindowThemeManager: setupThemeListener() WindowThemeManager->>WindowThemeManager: applyVisualEffects() WindowThemeManager->>WindowThemeManager: resolveIsDarkMode() WindowThemeManager->>BrowserWindow: applyMacVisualEffects() WindowThemeManager->>WebContents: once(did-finish-load, handler) WebContents-->>WindowThemeManager: did-finish-load WindowThemeManager->>WindowThemeManager: applyLiquidGlass() WindowThemeManager->>BrowserWindow: setWindowButtonVisibility(true) WindowThemeManager->>BrowserWindow: getNativeWindowHandle() BrowserWindow-->>WindowThemeManager: nativeHandle WindowThemeManager->>liquidGlassModule: addView(nativeHandle) liquidGlassModule-->>WindowThemeManager: viewId WindowThemeManager->>liquidGlassModule: unstable_setVariant(viewId, 2) ``` #### Class diagram for centralized WindowThemeManager visual effects ```mermaid classDiagram class WindowThemeManager { -string identifier -BrowserWindow browserWindow -boolean listenerSetup -function boundHandleThemeChange -number liquidGlassViewId +WindowThemeManager(identifier string) +attach(browserWindow BrowserWindow) void +cleanup() void +isDarkMode bool +useLiquidGlass bool +getPlatformConfig() any +applyVisualEffects() void +applyLiquidGlass() void -setupThemeListener() void -handleNativeThemeUpdated() void -resolveIsDarkMode() bool -applyWindowsVisualEffects(isDarkMode bool) void -getWindowsVisualConfig(isDarkMode bool) WindowsThemeConfig -applyMacVisualEffects() void } class Browser { -string identifier -WindowThemeManager themeManager -any options -any stateManager +createBrowserWindow() BrowserWindow +setupWindow(browserWindow BrowserWindow) void } class BrowserWindow { +setBackgroundColor(color string) void +setTitleBarOverlay(config any) void +setWindowButtonVisibility(visible bool) void +getNativeWindowHandle() Buffer +isDestroyed() bool +webContents WebContents } class WebContents { +once(event string, listener function) void } class WindowsThemeConfig { +string backgroundColor +any titleBarOverlay +string titleBarStyle } Browser --> WindowThemeManager : uses WindowThemeManager --> BrowserWindow : manages visual effects BrowserWindow --> WebContents : owns WindowThemeManager ..> WindowsThemeConfig : returns ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Centralize platform visual effects lifecycle (Windows + macOS) in WindowThemeManager, including new liquid glass support for macOS Tahoe. |
  • Lazily require electron-liquid-glass only on macOS Tahoe and track a liquidGlassViewId per window.
  • Extend WindowThemeManager lifecycle: attach now registers a did-finish-load hook and triggers applyLiquidGlass when appropriate; cleanup resets liquidGlassViewId.
  • Introduce useLiquidGlass getter to gate behavior on macOS Tahoe and module availability.
  • Update getPlatformConfig() to return transparent-only config for Tahoe with liquid glass, or vibrancy/visualEffectState for pre-Tahoe macOS.
  • Replace resolveWindowsIsDarkModeFromElectron with resolveIsDarkMode and make applyVisualEffects the single entry point dispatching to Windows and macOS handlers.
  • Add applyMacVisualEffects() that reapplies liquid glass at runtime when needed.
  • Add applyLiquidGlass() as an idempotent native view application that ensures traffic-light visibility and calls liquidGlass.addView/unstable_setVariant.
  • Adjust tests/mocks for WindowThemeManager to account for new env flags and themeSource handling.

  • Change the early return guard to use Array.isArray for strict array validation before mapping over groups.
  • Wrap group.topics in a fallback empty array before mapping to avoid errors when topics is undefined.
  • Preserve existing favorite toggle logic while ensuring no behavior change when data is well-formed.

@arvinxx Done! I've added regression tests and fixed the test assertion. The latest push includes:

**Regression tests added:**
1. `should handle groups with non-array topics field without throwing TypeError` - Tests that `favoriteTopic` doesn't throw `TypeError` when SWR cache contains groups with `null`, `undefined`, string, or object `topics` fields (instead of arrays)
2. `should correctly update favorite state in well-formed cache data` - Tests the happy path: correctly toggling favorite state in properly-formed cache data

The first test was failing because the assertion expected `group.topics` to be `[]`, but the actual correct behavior is that when no topic ID matches, the function returns the original groups array unchanged (via reference equality `===`). Fixed the assertion to match the real behavior -- the important thing is it doesn't throw a TypeError on `.map()`.

release workflows, and local test tooling), plus minor UI/modal API cleanups and infra helpers. #### Sequence diagram for desktop manual update check flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant TitleBar as TitleBar participant useUpdateModal as useUpdateModal participant UpdateModalContent as UpdateModalContent participant autoUpdateService as autoUpdateService participant MainProcess->>TitleBar: broadcast manualUpdateAvailable(info) TitleBar->>useUpdateModal: open(onAfterClose) useUpdateModal->>UpdateModalContent: render(stage=checking) UpdateModalContent->>UpdateModalContent: stage -> available User->>UpdateModalContent: Click downloadNewVersion UpdateModalContent->>autoUpdateService: downloadUpdate() autoUpdateService->>MainProcess: IPC updateDownloadStart MainProcess->>autoUpdater: downloadUpdate autoUpdater->>UpdateServer: Download package stream autoUpdater-->>MainProcess: downloadProgress, updateDownloaded(info) MainProcess->>UpdateModalContent: broadcast updateDownloadProgress, updateDownloaded(info) UpdateModalContent->>UpdateModalContent: stage -> downloading -> downloaded MainProcess->>UpdateModalContent: broadcast updateError(err.message) UpdateModalContent->>useUpdateModal: onClose() UpdateModalContent->>UpdateModalContent: modal.error(message) end ``` #### Updated class diagram for desktop updater and modal hooks ```mermaid classDiagram class UpdaterManager { -AppCore app -any mainWindow -boolean downloading -boolean updateAvailable -boolean isManualCheck -boolean usingFallbackProvider +constructor(app) +init() -configureUpdateProvider() -switchToFallbackAndRetry() Promise~boolean~ -resetToPrimaryProvider() void -registerEvents() void useWatchBroadcastHook { <> +useWatchBroadcast(event, handler) void -handlerRef } class AddFilesToKnowledgeBaseModalContent { <> +ModalContent(fileIds, knowledgeBaseId) } class useAddFilesToKnowledgeBaseModalHook { <> +useAddFilesToKnowledgeBaseModal() AddFilesModalController } class AddFilesModalController { +open(params) void } class KnowledgeBaseCreateModalContent { <> | ----- | | Add a public Next.js API route for exposing the app version without authentication. |

## Reviewer's Guide Implements group-aware history truncation and fully re-enables configurable history count in agent settings and engine flow, including UI controls, selectors, defaults, and comprehensive tests. #### Sequence diagram for group-aware history truncation in getSlicedMessages ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller as Caller participant HistoryTruncate as HistoryTruncate participant Maps as buildMessageMaps participant GroupStart as isGroupStart participant CollectGroup as collectGroupIds Caller->>HistoryTruncate: getSlicedMessages(messages, options) activate HistoryTruncate HistoryTruncate-->>Caller: [] when !options.enableHistoryCount deactivate HistoryTruncate Caller->>HistoryTruncate: getSlicedMessages(messages, options) activate HistoryTruncate HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: validate historyCount HistoryTruncate-->>Caller: [] when historyCount <= 0 deactivate HistoryTruncate Caller->>HistoryTruncate: getSlicedMessages(messages, options) activate HistoryTruncate HistoryTruncate->>Maps: buildMessageMaps(messages) Maps-->>HistoryTruncate: {messageMap, childrenMap} loop forward_over_messages HistoryTruncate->>GroupStart: isGroupStart(msg, messageMap, childrenMap) alt msg_is_group_start HistoryTruncate->>CollectGroup: collectGroupIds(msg.id, messageMap, childrenMap) CollectGroup-->>HistoryTruncate: Set(groupIds) HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: add groupIds to groups, map ids to groupIndex else msg_is_single HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: create single-message group end end loop backward_over_messages HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: lookup messageToGroup[msg.id] HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: add groupIndex to selectedGroupIndices until size == historyCount end HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: union all ids for selectedGroupIndices into selectedIds HistoryTruncate->>HistoryTruncate: result = messages.filter(id in selectedIds) HistoryTruncate-->>Caller: result deactivate HistoryTruncate ``` #### Class diagram for HistoryTruncateProcessor and related types ```mermaid classDiagram class BaseProcessor { <> } class HistoryTruncateConfig { +boolean enableHistoryCount +number historyCount } class MinimalMessage { +string id +string role +string agentId +string parentId +string tool_call_id +Array~ToolRef~ tools +Metadata metadata } class ToolRef { +string id } class Metadata { +boolean agentCouncil +boolean compare } class HistoryTruncateProcessor { +HistoryTruncateConfig config +process(context) } class MessagesEngineConfig { +boolean enableHistoryCount +number historyCount } class MessagesEngine { -MessagesEngineConfig config +buildProcessors() } BaseProcessor <|-- HistoryTruncateProcessor HistoryTruncateProcessor --> HistoryTruncateConfig MessagesEngine --> HistoryTruncateProcessor MessagesEngine --> MessagesEngineConfig MinimalMessage --> ToolRef MinimalMessage --> Metadata ``` #### Flow diagram for updated MessagesEngine pipeline with HistoryTruncateProcessor ```mermaid flowchart TD A[MessagesEngine.buildProcessors] A --> B[Phase1_Message_Validation] B --> C[Phase2_Context_Injection] C --> D[Phase3_History_Summary] D --> E[PageSelectionsInjector] E --> F[PageEditorContextInjector] F --> G[HistorySummaryProcessor] G --> H[HistoryTruncateProcessor\nuses enableHistoryCount, historyCount] H --> I[InputTemplateProcessor] I --> J[PlaceholderVariablesProcessor] J --> K[AgentCouncilFlattenProcessor] K --> L[GroupMessageFlattenProcessor] L --> M[TasksFlattenProcessor] M --> N[TaskMessageProcessor] N --> O[SupervisorRoleRestoreProcessor] O --> P[CompressedGroupRoleTransformProcessor] P --> Q{isAgentGroupEnabled?} Q -- yes --> R[GroupOrchestrationFilterProcessor] R --> S[GroupRoleTransformProcessor] Q -- no --> S S --> T[MessageContentProcessor] T --> U[ToolCallProcessor] U --> V[ToolMessageReorder] V --> W[MessageCleanupProcessor] classDef processor fill:#eef,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px class B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I,J,K,L,M,N,O,P,R,S,T,U,V,W processor ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add group-aware history truncation logic that treats logical frontend groups (assistant tool chains, agent council, compare, tasks) as single units when enforcing historyCount. |
  • Introduce MinimalMessage type and helper maps to track parent/child relationships among messages.
  • Implement detection of group starts for AssistantGroup, AgentCouncil, Compare, and multi-task sets using metadata, roles, and parentId relationships.
  • Implement collectAssistantGroupIds and collectGroupIds to gather all message IDs belonging to a logical group, with rules for agentId continuity, agentCouncil boundaries, compare messages, and task siblings.
  • Update getSlicedMessages to build groups, map messages to group indices, select the last N groups based on historyCount, and filter the original messages accordingly while logging truncation details.
  • Adjust HistoryTruncateProcessor to use the new group-aware getSlicedMessages and update its logging message.
| `packages/context-engine/src/processors/HistoryTruncate.ts` | | Cover new group-aware truncation behaviors with unit tests for different grouping patterns. |
  • Add tests to verify AssistantGroup chains count as a single unit and stop when agentId changes.
  • Add tests to verify AgentCouncil tool messages plus children, Compare groups, and Tasks groups each count as single units.
  • Add a mixed-groups test ensuring the last N groups are selected correctly across combinations of user and grouped messages.
| `packages/context-engine/src/processors/__tests__/HistoryTruncate.test.ts` | | Wire historyCount configuration back into the messages engine pipeline so truncation runs at the appropriate phase. |
  • Update MessagesEngine constructor parameters to accept enableHistoryCount and historyCount from config.
  • Insert HistoryTruncateProcessor into the processor pipeline before InputTemplate and adjust step numbering comments accordingly.
  • Ensure downstream processors run on already-truncated, group-aware message lists.
| `packages/context-engine/src/engine/messages/MessagesEngine.ts` | | Re-expose and synchronize history count controls in the chat input parameters UI. |
  • Watch enableHistoryCount from the params form, and read enableHistoryCount/historyCount from the agent store via chatConfigByIdSelectors.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a settings icon to the mobile chat header that navigates to the correct agent settings page using the active agent ID, restores missing Agent Settings tab content on mobile/PWA, and configures pnpm to only build a defined set of native/heavy dependencies. #### Sequence diagram for opening agent settings from mobile chat header ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant MobileHeader participant AgentStore participant Router User->>MobileHeader: Tap Settings icon MobileHeader->>AgentStore: get activeAgentId AgentStore-->>MobileHeader: activeAgentId alt activeAgentId exists MobileHeader->>Router: navigate /agent/{activeAgentId}/settings Router-->>User: Render AgentSettings page else activeAgentId missing MobileHeader-->>User: No navigation (no-op) end ``` #### Updated class diagram for AgentSettingsContent tab rendering ```mermaid classDiagram class AgentSettingsContent { ReactNode loadingSkeleton ChatSettingsTabs tab ReactNode~ReactNode~ children +render() } class ChatSettingsTabs { <> Meta Prompt Opening Chat Modal TTS } class AgentMeta { +render() } class AgentPrompt { +render() } class AgentOpening { +render() } class AgentChat { +render() } class AgentModal { +render() } class AgentTTS { +render() } AgentSettingsContent --> ChatSettingsTabs : uses tab AgentSettingsContent --> AgentMeta : renders when tab Meta AgentSettingsContent --> AgentPrompt : renders when tab Prompt AgentSettingsContent --> AgentOpening : renders when tab Opening AgentSettingsContent --> AgentChat : renders when tab Chat AgentSettingsContent --> AgentModal : renders when tab Modal AgentSettingsContent --> AgentTTS : renders when tab TTS ``` #### Class diagram for MobileHeader settings navigation logic ```mermaid classDiagram class MobileHeader { +boolean open +handleOpenSettings() +render() } class AgentStore { +string activeAgentId } class QueryRouteHook { +push(path, query, replace) } class RouterNavigateHook { +navigate(path) } class ChatHeaderComponent { +onBackClick() +right } MobileHeader --> AgentStore : reads activeAgentId MobileHeader --> QueryRouteHook : uses onBackClick MobileHeader --> RouterNavigateHook : uses navigate to settings MobileHeader --> ChatHeaderComponent : configures right actions ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ## Reviewer's Guide Adds a GitHub Actions workflow that automatically syncs changes from main to dev by creating a PR from a temporary sync branch whenever main is updated. #### Sequence diagram for automatic main-to-dev sync workflow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Developer participant GitHub participant Sync_Workflow participant GitHub_API Developer->>GitHub: Push commits to main GitHub-->>Sync_Workflow: Trigger workflow on main push Sync_Workflow->>GitHub: Checkout repository (fetch-depth 0) Sync_Workflow->>Sync_Workflow: Configure git user Sync_Workflow->>Sync_Workflow: Set SYNC_BRANCH_MAIN_DEV Sync_Workflow->>GitHub: Checkout main Sync_Workflow->>GitHub: Create or reset sync branch Sync_Workflow->>GitHub: Compute diff origin/dev... alt No differences between main and dev Sync_Workflow-->>GitHub: Exit workflow (no changes) else Differences detected Sync_Workflow->>GitHub: Push sync branch to origin Sync_Workflow->>GitHub_API: Create PR base dev head sync branch GitHub_API-->>Developer: New PR "Sync main branch to dev branch" end ``` #### Flow diagram for sync-main-to-dev GitHub Actions job ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Push to main branch"] --> B["Workflow sync-main-to-dev.yaml starts"] B --> C["Checkout repository with fetch-depth 0"] C --> D["Configure git user name and email"] D --> E["Set env SYNC_BRANCH_MAIN_DEV=sync/main-to-dev-YYYYMMDD"] E --> F["Checkout main and create or reset sync branch"] F --> G["Compute DIFF = git diff origin/dev..."] G --> H{Is DIFF empty?} H -->|Yes| I["Log 'No changes to sync' and exit 0"] H -->|No| J["Push sync branch to origin with force"] J --> K["Call gh pr create base dev head sync branch"] K --> L{PR creation successful?} L -->|Yes| M["Workflow ends (PR open)"] L -->|No| N["Ignore error and exit 0"] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a GitHub Actions workflow that creates an automated PR from main to dev on pushes to main. |
  • Add a workflow triggered on pushes to the main branch
  • Configure checkout with full history and set global Git user identity for the action
  • Generate a dated sync branch name stored in the workflow environment
  • Create/reset a sync branch from main, detect diffs against origin/dev, and push the branch only when there are changes
  • Use the GitHub CLI with the workflow token to open or no-op on a PR from the sync branch into dev
| `.github/workflows/sync-main-to-dev.yaml` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Implements multimodal-aware streaming for Gemini 3 image models by threading `isMultimodal` + `tempDisplayContent` metadata from the low-level streaming handler through the executor and optimistic-update pipeline so image content_parts are rendered as images instead of raw base64, with comprehensive unit and integration tests covering the new behavior. #### Sequence diagram for multimodal content_metadata propagation during streaming ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ModelStream participant StreamingHandler participant StreamingExecutor participant MessageDispatcher participant MessageStore User->>ModelStream: Send prompt to Gemini 3 image model ModelStream-->>StreamingHandler: StreamChunk type content_part with image StreamingHandler->>StreamingHandler: Append to contentParts StreamingHandler->>StreamingHandler: Detect hasContentImages = true StreamingHandler->>StreamingExecutor: onContentUpdate(content, reasoning, contentMetadata) activate StreamingExecutor StreamingExecutor->>MessageDispatcher: internal_dispatchMessage(updateMessage { content, reasoning, metadata { isMultimodal, tempDisplayContent } }) deactivate StreamingExecutor activate MessageDispatcher MessageDispatcher->>MessageStore: messageOptimisticUpdate(updateMessage, { metadata }) MessageStore-->>User: Render images using isMultimodal and tempDisplayContent deactivate MessageDispatcher ``` #### Class diagram for updated streaming types and handlers ```mermaid classDiagram class StreamingCallbacks { +onContentUpdate(content: string, reasoning: ReasoningState, contentMetadata: ContentMetadata) void +onGroundingUpdate(grounding: GroundingData) void +onImageUpdate(images: Base64Image[]) void } class ContentMetadata { +isMultimodal: boolean +tempDisplayContent: string } class StreamingHandler { -contentParts: ContentPart[] -thinkingContent: string -thinkingDuration: number +notifyContentPartUpdate() void +buildReasoningState() ReasoningState } class StreamingExecutor { +streamingExecutor() void } class MessageDispatcher { +internal_dispatchMessage(action: UpdateMessageAction, context: DispatchContext) void } class MessageOptimisticUpdate { +messageOptimisticUpdate(action: UpdateMessageAction, context: DispatchContext) void } class StreamChunk_text { +text: string +type: string } class StreamChunk_reasoning { +text: string +type: string } class StreamChunk_reasoning_part { +content: string +mimeType: string +partType: string +type: string } class StreamChunk_content_part { +content: string +mimeType: string +partType: string +type: string } class StreamChunk_tool_calls { +isAnimationActives: boolean[] +tool_calls: MessageToolCall[] +type: string } class StreamChunk_grounding { +grounding: GroundingData +type: string } class StreamChunk_base64_image { +image: ImageData +images: ImageData[] +type: string } class ImageData { +data: string +id: string } class UpdateMessageAction { +id: string +type: string +value: UpdateMessageValue } class UpdateMessageValue { +content: string +reasoning: ReasoningState +metadata: ContentMetadata } class DispatchContext { +operationId: string +metadata: ContentMetadata } class GroundingData class ReasoningState class MessageToolCall class ContentPart StreamingHandler --> StreamingCallbacks : uses StreamingExecutor --> StreamingHandler : creates StreamingExecutor --> StreamingCallbacks : implements StreamingExecutor --> MessageDispatcher : calls MessageDispatcher --> MessageOptimisticUpdate : calls MessageDispatcher --> UpdateMessageAction : creates UpdateMessageAction --> UpdateMessageValue : has UpdateMessageValue --> ContentMetadata : has StreamingCallbacks --> ContentMetadata : uses StreamingCallbacks --> GroundingData : uses StreamChunk_content_part --> ContentPart : mapsTo StreamChunk_base64_image --> ImageData : has StreamChunk_grounding --> GroundingData : uses StreamChunk_reasoning_part --> ReasoningState : contributesTo ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Extend streaming callbacks and handler to emit multimodal metadata when image content_parts are present. |
  • Updated `StreamingCallbacks.onContentUpdate` to accept an optional `contentMetadata` argument containing `isMultimodal` and a serialized `tempDisplayContent` representation of content parts.
  • Modified `StreamChunk` type definitions formatting and kept support for `content_part`, `reasoning_part`, `base64_image`, `grounding`, and `tool_calls` chunks intact.
  • Changed `StreamingHandler.notifyContentPartUpdate` to always call `onContentUpdate` with reasoning state and, when any content image parts exist, pass `contentMetadata` with `isMultimodal: true` and `tempDisplayContent` built via `serializePartsForStorage(this.contentParts)`.
  • Ensured `StreamingHandler.handleFinish` sets `metadata.isMultimodal` and serializes multimodal content into JSON only when content includes images, leaving plain-text flows unchanged.
| `src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/types/streaming.ts`
`src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/StreamingHandler.ts` | | Thread multimodal metadata through streaming executor and optimistic update so the UI can render images during streaming and avoid base64/JSON flashes. |
  • Updated `streamingExecutor` to pass the new `contentMetadata` parameter from `StreamingHandler.onContentUpdate` into `internal_dispatchMessage`, mapping it onto `value.metadata.isMultimodal` and `value.metadata.tempDisplayContent` for `updateMessage` actions.
  • Modified `messageOptimisticUpdate` to include `extra?.metadata` on the optimistic `updateMessage` dispatch so `isMultimodal` and `tempDisplayContent` are available before the database write completes.
  • Kept non-multimodal text streaming behavior unchanged, ensuring `isMultimodal` metadata is only attached for content containing images.
| `src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/streamingExecutor.ts`
`src/store/chat/slices/message/actions/optimisticUpdate.ts` | | Add targeted unit and integration tests to validate multimodal streaming behavior and metadata propagation. |
  • Introduced a new `StreamingHandler.test.ts` suite that covers content_part image vs text handling, reasoning and reasoning_part (including image reasoning), tool_calls, base64_image upload + imageList metadata, and grounding propagation, including assertions on `contentMetadata.isMultimodal` and `tempDisplayContent`.
  • Extended `streamingExecutor.test.ts` with a new "content_part multimodal streaming" describe block that mocks Gemini image models and file upload, and verifies `internal_dispatchMessage` and `optimisticUpdateMessageContent` receive `metadata.isMultimodal` and `tempDisplayContent` for multimodal streams but not for plain text streams.
| `src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/__tests__/StreamingHandler.test.ts`
`src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/__tests__/streamingExecutor.test.ts` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Centers the currently active model in the chat model switch panel when it opens by computing the active item index and using it to set the virtualized list’s initial scroll position. #### Sequence diagram for centering the active model when the panel opens ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ChatPage participant ModelSwitchPanel participant List participant Virtuoso User->>ChatPage: Open model switch panel ChatPage->>ModelSwitchPanel: Render with current provider and model ModelSwitchPanel->>List: Render with listItems, provider, model List->>List: Compute activeKey List->>List: Compute activeIndex via useMemo List->>Virtuoso: Render with initialTopMostItemIndex Virtuoso-->>User: Display list with active model centered (if found) ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Center the active model in the model switch panel when opened by integrating active-item detection with the virtualized list’s initial scroll position. |
  • Compute the index of the active model in the list using useMemo by matching against different item types (provider-model-item, model-item-single, model-item-multiple) via menuKey comparisons.
  • Handle cases where no active model is found by returning -1 from the memoized index calculation.
  • Configure the Virtuoso list to start with the active model centered using initialTopMostItemIndex when a valid active index exists, or fall back to index 0 otherwise.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/index.tsx` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#[Request] Mouse hover shows model list, suggest positioning to that model location**: PR makes the opened model switch panel center on the active model, matching the requested auto-positioning behavior. ---

## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts memory layer prompt templates to use explicit newline literals instead of empty strings and extends the identity layer prompt to proactively create identity entries when none exist, even allowing low-confidence assumptions to bootstrap coverage. #### Sequence diagram for updated identity layer extraction behavior ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant App participant MemoryService participant IdentityExtractorLLM participant MemoryStore User->>App: Send conversation App->>MemoryService: extractIdentityMemories(conversation) MemoryService->>MemoryStore: getExistingIdentities(userId) MemoryStore-->>MemoryService: existingIdentitiesContext MemoryService->>IdentityExtractorLLM: identityPrompt(conversation, existingIdentitiesContext) alt existingIdentitiesContext is empty or missing IdentityExtractorLLM-->>MemoryService: withIdentities(add many proactive, allow low scoreConfidence) else existingIdentitiesContext has entries IdentityExtractorLLM-->>MemoryService: withIdentities(add/update/remove, conservative deduplication) end MemoryService->>MemoryStore: applyIdentityActions(withIdentities) MemoryStore-->>MemoryService: updatedIdentities MemoryService-->>App: identityExtractionResult App-->>User: Confirmation or silently improved personalization ``` #### Flow diagram for identity layer extraction when no existing entries ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Start identity extraction] --> B[Load existingIdentitiesContext] B --> C{existingIdentitiesContext is empty or missing?} C -->|Yes| D[Set extraction mode to proactive] C -->|No| E[Set extraction mode to conservative] D --> F[Scan conversation for all identity-related signals] F --> G[Allow inferred personal attributes and roles with lower scoreConfidence] G --> H[Generate many initial identity memories in withIdentities.actions.add] H --> M[Ensure update and remove arrays exist but are usually empty] E --> I[Compare conversation against existing identity entries] I --> J[Extract only NEW or MATERIALLY UPDATED identity facts] J --> K[Populate add, update, remove arrays with minimal duplication] K --> M[Ensure add, update, remove arrays present] M --> N[Return JSON with withIdentities add, update, remove] N --> O[End identity extraction] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Standardize prompt formatting across memory layers to use explicit newline markers instead of empty string separators. |

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/d11dde5ca52f0786306ff577c1f2a336f23e554e/src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/skills.ts#L53-L55 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Route zip URL imports to ZIP parser** When `importSkill` is called with `type: 'zip'`, `SkillsExecutionRuntime` dispatches to `importFromZipUrl`, but the server-side implementation currently calls `importer.importFromUrl`. That path expects a plain `SKILL.md` payload, so a ZIP URL will be fetched as text and parsed with the markdown/YAML parser, leading to parse failures instead of a successful ZIP import. This means any ZIP URL import attempt (e.g., users choosing the “upload zip / zip url” path for skills) will consistently fail even though the feature is exposed.

## Reviewer's Guide This PR translates existing Chinese comments in the image generation store (batch actions, config hooks, and initial state) into clear English while preserving behavior and structure, focusing solely on documentation clarity around deletion flows, polling/backoff logic, optimistic updates, and aspect-ratio handling. #### Sequence diagram for generation deletion with optimistic update and empty batch cleanup ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant UI participant Store participant GenerationService participant GenerationBatchService User->>UI: Click delete generation UI->>Store: deleteGeneration(generationId) Store->>Store: Find batch containing generation alt Batch found Store->>Store: internal_dispatchGenerationBatch activate Store Store-->>Store: Optimistically remove generation from batch deactivate Store Store->>GenerationService: deleteGeneration(generationId) GenerationService-->>Store: Deletion result Store->>Store: refreshGenerationBatches() Store-->>Store: Reload batches for activeGenerationTopicId Store->>Store: Check for empty batches alt Empty batches exist loop For each empty batch Store->>Store: internal_dispatchGenerationBatch activate Store Store-->>Store: Optimistically remove empty batch deactivate Store Store->>GenerationBatchService: deleteGenerationBatch(batchId) GenerationBatchService-->>Store: Deletion result end Store->>Store: refreshGenerationBatches() Store-->>Store: Ensure consistency after cleanup else No empty batches Store-->>Store: No additional cleanup end else Batch not found Store-->>UI: No-op end Store-->>UI: Updated batches state ``` #### Sequence diagram for generation status polling with exponential backoff and topic cover update ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Component participant SWRHook as SWR_useGenerationStatus participant Store participant GenerationService participant TopicSelectors Component->>SWRHook: useGenerationStatus(generationId, asyncTaskId) SWRHook->>Store: Get requestCountRef, isErrorRef loop Polling cycle SWRHook->>Store: Increment requestCountRef SWRHook->>GenerationService: getGenerationStatus(generationId, asyncTaskId) GenerationService-->>SWRHook: GetGenerationStatusResult alt Error occurred SWRHook->>Store: Set isErrorRef = true SWRHook-->>Component: Error state SWRHook->>SWRHook: Compute next interval SWRHook-->>SWRHook: Use exponential backoff * 2 after error else Success response SWRHook->>Store: Set isErrorRef = false SWRHook->>Store: Read generationBatchesMap[topicId] Store-->>SWRHook: Current batches SWRHook->>SWRHook: Find batch containing generationId alt Status is Success or Error and batch found SWRHook->>Store: Reset requestCountRef = 0 alt data.generation exists SWRHook->>Store: internal_dispatchGenerationBatch Store-->>Store: Update generation data in batch alt Status is Success and thumbnailUrl exists SWRHook->>TopicSelectors: getGenerationTopicById(topicId) TopicSelectors-->>SWRHook: currentTopic alt currentTopic.coverUrl is empty SWRHook->>Store: updateGenerationTopicCover(topicId, thumbnailUrl) else Topic already has cover SWRHook-->>Store: Skip cover update end else No thumbnail or not success SWRHook-->>Store: Skip cover update end else No generation in response SWRHook-->>Store: Skip generation update end SWRHook->>Store: refreshGenerationBatches() Store-->>Store: Reload batches for topic else Status pending or batch not found SWRHook-->>Store: Keep polling end alt Status is Success or Error break Stop polling loop SWRHook-->>SWRHook: Next interval = 0 (stop polling) end else Pending status SWRHook->>SWRHook: Compute next interval SWRHook-->>SWRHook: Exponential backoff up to 30s end end end SWRHook-->>Component: Final generation status and updated store state ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Clarified batch deletion and optimistic update flow comments in generation batch actions. |
  • Documented post-deletion empty-batch cleanup and subsequent refresh behavior in English.
  • Explained optimistic update steps when deleting a generation from a batch.
  • Described the internal batch deletion flow and its backend call/refresh sequence.
| `src/store/image/slices/generationBatch/action.ts` | | Improved documentation of generation status polling, backoff, and error handling. |
  • Commented request-count-based exponential backoff logic for polling intervals.
  • Clarified how error state affects polling intervals and how it is reset on success.
  • Explained how generation status updates propagate to batches and topic cover images, and when batches are refreshed.
| `src/store/image/slices/generationBatch/action.ts` | | Clarified aspect ratio/dimension configuration behavior in hooks and state. |
  • Documented how aspect ratio options are selected from schema vs preset values.
  • Explained when the dimension control container should be shown based on supported controls.
  • Clarified meaning of activeAspectRatio values and initialization flag semantics.

## Reviewer's Guide Configures a tag-driven release pipeline and adds an interactive release-branch helper script: releases are now triggered by version tags created automatically from merged release PRs or manually via a CLI that bumps versions, creates a release branch, and opens a PR. #### Sequence diagram for the new tag-driven release pipeline ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Maintainer participant ReleaseScript as ReleaseScript_CLI participant Git as Local_Git participant GitHub as GitHub_Repo participant AutoTag as AutoTagRelease_Workflow participant Tag as Git_Tag_vX_X_X participant ReleaseCI as Release_Workflow participant SemRel as SemanticRelease Maintainer->>ReleaseScript: run npm_script release:branch ReleaseScript->>Git: checkGitRepo ReleaseScript->>Git: checkoutAndPullDev (dev) ReleaseScript->>ReleaseScript: getCurrentVersion from package.json ReleaseScript->>ReleaseScript: bumpVersion (patch|minor|major) ReleaseScript->>Maintainer: confirmRelease(newVersion) alt Maintainer cancels Maintainer-->>ReleaseScript: cancel ReleaseScript-->>Maintainer: exit else Maintainer confirms ReleaseScript->>Git: createReleaseBranch release/vX_X_X ReleaseScript->>Git: commit --allow-empty "chore(release): prepare release vX.X.X" ReleaseScript->>GitHub: push branch release/vX_X_X ReleaseScript->>GitHub: gh pr create GitHub-->>Maintainer: PR 🚀 release: vX.X.X opened end Maintainer->>GitHub: merge PR into main GitHub->>AutoTag: trigger on pull_request.closed (main) AutoTag->>AutoTag: check PR title pattern alt Title matches release pattern AutoTag->>AutoTag: extract version X.X.X AutoTag->>GitHub: check if tag vX.X.X exists alt Tag does not exist AutoTag->>GitHub: git tag -a vX.X.X merge_commit AutoTag->>GitHub: git push origin vX.X.X AutoTag->>GitHub: create GitHub Release vX.X.X GitHub->>ReleaseCI: trigger on push tag vX.X.X ReleaseCI->>ReleaseCI: Extract version from tag ReleaseCI->>ReleaseCI: Update package.json version ReleaseCI->>GitHub: commit and push package.json to main ReleaseCI->>SemRel: run semantic-release with SEMANTIC_RELEASE_VERSION SemRel-->>ReleaseCI: publish artifacts and releases else Tag already exists AutoTag-->>GitHub: skip tag and release end else Not a release PR AutoTag-->>GitHub: no-op end ``` #### Flow diagram for the updated GitHub Actions release architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Maintainer runs release:branch script] --> B[Release script checks Git repo and dev branch] B --> C[Read current version from package.json] C --> D[Determine bump type patch/minor/major] D --> E[Calculate new semantic version] E --> F[Show confirmation summary] F -->|Confirmed| G[Create branch release/vX.X.X and marker commit] F -->|Cancelled| Z[Exit without changes] G --> H[Push release branch to origin] H --> I[Create PR to main with title 🚀 release: vX.X.X] I --> J[Maintainer reviews and merges PR into main] subgraph AutoTagRelease_Workflow J --> K[Trigger on pull_request closed targeting main] K --> L[Match PR title against release pattern] L -->|Not release PR| L1[Stop, no tag] L -->|Release PR| M[Extract version X.X.X from title] M --> N[Check if tag vX.X.X exists] N -->|Exists| N1[Log and skip tagging] N -->|Does not exist| O[Create annotated tag vX.X.X at merge commit] O --> P[Push tag vX.X.X] P --> Q[Create GitHub Release vX.X.X] end subgraph Release_Workflow_on_Tag P --> R[Trigger release.yml on push tag v*.*.*] R --> S[Extract version X.X.X from tag ref] S --> T[Update package.json version to X.X.X] T --> U[Commit and push package.json to main] U --> V[Run semantic-release with SEMANTIC_RELEASE_VERSION] end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Switch release workflow to be driven by version tag pushes and sync package.json/semantic-release with the tag version. |

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/6ad1eddf291e6f0a82ce8072e84d5145b96572cd/packages/model-runtime/src/providers/githubCopilot/index.ts#L242-L245 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Clear cached bearer token before retrying 401** On a 401, the retry path only invalidates `tokenManager` but does not clear `this.cachedBearerToken`, so the next attempt still prefers the same stale bearer token and never performs a fresh token exchange. This means OAuth/PAT-backed Copilot calls can keep failing through all retries whenever the cached bearer is revoked/invalid even though a refresh credential is present. --- https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/6ad1eddf291e6f0a82ce8072e84d5145b96572cd/src/server/routers/lambda/oauthDeviceFlow.ts#L147-L150 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Propagate Copilot auth-flow errors from pollAuthStatus** This catch block swallows every exception from `completeAuthFlow` (including token-exchange/user-info failures) and repolls instead, so hard failures are converted into generic poll statuses. In the authorized-but-not-entitled case (e.g., Copilot exchange returns 403), clients never receive the real error and can observe misleading `success`/`pending` states without credentials being persisted.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Refines GitHub Copilot provider auth retry behavior by switching to a boolean auth-refresh guard and explicitly clearing the cached bearer token on 401, while leaving rate-limit retries unchanged and removing the unused auth refresh constant. #### Sequence diagram for GitHub Copilot auth retry on 401 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller participant LobeGithubCopilotAI participant GithubCopilotAPI participant tokenManager Caller->>LobeGithubCopilotAI: executeWithRetry(fn) loop until success or max attempts LobeGithubCopilotAI->>GithubCopilotAPI: fn() using cachedBearerToken GithubCopilotAPI-->>LobeGithubCopilotAI: 401 Unauthorized alt first 401 and hasRefreshedAuth is false LobeGithubCopilotAI->>LobeGithubCopilotAI: set hasRefreshedAuth = true LobeGithubCopilotAI->>LobeGithubCopilotAI: cachedBearerToken = undefined LobeGithubCopilotAI->>tokenManager: invalidate(githubToken) LobeGithubCopilotAI->>LobeGithubCopilotAI: continue retry loop else subsequent 401 or hasRefreshedAuth is true LobeGithubCopilotAI-->>Caller: throw 401 error end end ``` #### Class diagram for updated LobeGithubCopilotAI retry logic ```mermaid classDiagram class LobeGithubCopilotAI { - cachedBearerToken string - githubToken string - MAX_TOTAL_ATTEMPTS number - MAX_RATE_LIMIT_RETRIES number + executeWithRetry(fn PromiseT) PromiseT } class TokenManager { + invalidate(githubToken string) void } LobeGithubCopilotAI --> TokenManager : uses ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Adjust auth retry loop to use a single refresh flag and clear cached tokens on 401 responses instead of counting refresh attempts. |
  • Replace numeric auth refresh counter with a boolean hasRefreshedAuth flag in executeWithRetry
  • On first 401 response, set hasRefreshedAuth to true and clear cachedBearerToken before invalidating the GitHub token and retrying
  • Remove the unused MAX_AUTH_REFRESH constant to simplify retry configuration and ensure rate limit retry logic is unaffected
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/githubCopilot/index.ts` |

## Reviewer's Guide Adds server-side support for executing code-interpreter built-in tools (execScript and exportFile) within the skills runtime, wiring them through MarketService and S3-backed file handling, and aligning the shared CommandResult type across packages while improving skill lookup error handling in both the skills runtime and market router. #### Sequence diagram for execScript in skills runtime ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant SkillsExecutionRuntime participant SkillServerRuntimeService participant AgentSkillModel participant FileModel participant FileService participant MarketService participant MarketPlugins SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillServerRuntimeService: execScript(command, options) SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: validate topicId alt config has name SkillServerRuntimeService->>AgentSkillModel: findByName(config.name) alt skill not found SkillServerRuntimeService->>AgentSkillModel: findAll() AgentSkillModel-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: allSkills SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: CommandResult{success false, stderr SkillNotFound} else skill found alt skill has zipFileHash SkillServerRuntimeService->>FileModel: checkHash(skill.zipFileHash) FileModel-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: fileInfo{isExist,url} alt fileInfo.isExist and url SkillServerRuntimeService->>FileService: getFullFileUrl(fileInfo.url) FileService-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: fullUrl SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: add zipUrl to enhancedParams end end end end SkillServerRuntimeService->>MarketService: get market MarketService-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: market SkillServerRuntimeService->>MarketPlugins: runBuildInTool(execScript, enhancedParams, {topicId,userId}) MarketPlugins-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: response{success,data,error} alt response.success SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: map result to CommandResult SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: CommandResult{success true, output, stderr} else response failed SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: CommandResult{success false, stderr} end ``` #### Sequence diagram for exportFile in skills runtime ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant SkillsExecutionRuntime participant SkillServerRuntimeService participant FileS3 participant MarketService participant MarketPlugins participant FileService SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillServerRuntimeService: exportFile(path, filename) SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: validate topicId SkillServerRuntimeService->>FileS3: new FileS3() SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: build S3 key using date and topicId SkillServerRuntimeService->>FileS3: createPreSignedUrl(key) FileS3-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: uploadUrl SkillServerRuntimeService->>MarketService: get market MarketService-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: market SkillServerRuntimeService->>MarketPlugins: runBuildInTool(exportFile, {path,uploadUrl}, {topicId,userId}) MarketPlugins-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: response{success,data} alt response.success SkillServerRuntimeService->>FileS3: getFileMetadata(key) FileS3-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: metadata{contentLength,contentType} SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: compute fileHash using sha256(key+timestamp) SkillServerRuntimeService->>FileService: createFileRecord{fileHash,fileType,name,size,url} FileService-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: {fileId,url} SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: ExportFileResult{success true,fileId,filename,url} else response failed SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: ExportFileResult{success false,filename} end ``` #### Updated class diagram for SkillServerRuntimeService and dependencies ```mermaid classDiagram class SkillServerRuntimeService { -SkillImporter importer -SkillResourceService resourceService -AgentSkillModel skillModel -MarketService marketService -FileService fileService -FileModel fileModel -string userId -string topicId +SkillServerRuntimeService(options) +findAll() Promise~SkillListItemResult~ +findOne(id) Promise~SkillItem~ +readResource(id, path) Promise~SkillResourceContent~ +execScript(command, options) Promise~CommandResult~ +exportFile(path, filename) Promise~ExportFileResult~ } class SkillImporter { } class SkillResourceService { } class AgentSkillModel { +constructor(serverDB, userId) +findAll() Promise~SkillListItemResult~ +findOne(id) Promise~SkillItem~ +findByName(name) Promise~SkillItem~ } class MarketService { +market MarketClient +constructor(options) } class FileService { +constructor(serverDB, userId) +getFullFileUrl(key) Promise~string~ +createFileRecord(params) Promise~CreateFileRecordResult~ } class FileModel { +constructor(serverDB, userId) +checkHash(hash) Promise~FileInfo~ } class FileS3 { +createPreSignedUrl(key) Promise~string~ +getFileMetadata(key) Promise~FileMetadata~ } class SkillsExecutionRuntime { -SkillRuntimeService service -BuiltinSkills builtinSkills +constructor(options) } class skillsRuntime { +factory(context) SkillsExecutionRuntime } SkillServerRuntimeService --> SkillImporter : uses SkillServerRuntimeService --> SkillResourceService : uses SkillServerRuntimeService --> AgentSkillModel : uses SkillServerRuntimeService --> MarketService : uses SkillServerRuntimeService --> FileService : uses SkillServerRuntimeService --> FileModel : uses SkillServerRuntimeService --> FileS3 : instantiates SkillsExecutionRuntime --> SkillServerRuntimeService : uses skillsRuntime --> SkillsExecutionRuntime : creates skillsRuntime --> AgentSkillModel : creates skillsRuntime --> SkillResourceService : creates skillsRuntime --> SkillImporter : creates skillsRuntime --> MarketService : creates skillsRuntime --> FileService : creates skillsRuntime --> FileModel : creates ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Extend SkillServerRuntimeService to support execScript via market-sdk, including optional skill zip resolution and robust error handling. |
  • Add MarketService, FileService, FileModel, topicId, and userId dependencies to SkillServerRuntimeService and its factory wiring in skillsRuntime.
  • Implement execScript method that validates topicId, optionally resolves a skill by name and its zipFileHash to a full S3 URL, enriches parameters with zipUrl, and calls market.plugins.runBuildInTool('execScript').
  • Normalize the execScript response into a CommandResult shape with exitCode, output, stderr, and success flags, including detailed error logging and fallbacks when the sandbox call fails or throws.
| `src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/skills.ts` | | Implement exportFile in the skills runtime to export sandbox files to S3 and persist metadata using FileService/FileS3. |
  • Add ExportFileResult support and a new exportFile method on SkillServerRuntimeService that requires topicId.
  • Generate a date- and topic-scoped S3 key, obtain a pre-signed upload URL via FileS3, and call market.plugins.runBuildInTool('exportFile') with the upload URL and sandbox path.
  • On success, fetch S3 metadata, derive mime type and file size, create a persistent file record with a hashed key via FileService, and return a structured ExportFileResult with the permanent file URL; on failure, log and return a failed result.
| `src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/skills.ts` | | Wire skillsRuntime factory with new dependencies and context (topicId, userId) required by the enhanced skills runtime. |
  • Instantiate MarketService, FileService, and FileModel in the skillsRuntime factory using the current request context.
  • Pass fileModel, fileService, marketService, topicId, and userId into the SkillServerRuntimeService constructor alongside existing importer, resourceService, and skillModel.
| `src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/skills.ts` | | Improve execScript handling in the market router to return structured errors when skills are missing and simplify file model usage. |
  • Add logic to execScript handling that, when a configured skill name is not found, fetches all skills, builds a human-readable list of available skill names, logs the condition, and returns a failed CallToolResult with a SkillNotFound error.
  • Remove dynamic imports of AgentSkillModel and FileModel in favor of direct usage where already available, and continue resolving zipFileHash to a full S3 URL via FileService and FileModel.
| `src/server/routers/tools/market.ts` | | Expose CommandResult type from builtin-tool-skills to standardize execScript return typing. |
  • Export CommandResult from the builtin-tool-skills package index so it can be reused by server runtimes.
  • Update skills runtime imports to use the shared CommandResult type instead of local ad-hoc shapes.

## Reviewer's Guide Extends the auto-tag GitHub Action and release tooling to support hotfix PRs and to tag the exact bumped-version commit, introduces a dedicated hotfix workflow script, simplifies the release workflow branch creation, and removes environment-gated filtering for business settings tabs while updating a UI dependency and release workflow checks. #### Class diagram for new hotfix workflow module ```mermaid classDiagram class HotfixWorkflow { +string ROOT_DIR +string PACKAGE_JSON_PATH +checkGitRepo() +getCurrentBranch() string +getCurrentVersion() string +bumpPatchVersion(currentVersion string) string +createHotfixBranchName(version string) string +confirmHotfix(branchName string, currentVersion string, isExistingBranch boolean, version string) Promise~boolean~ +createHotfixBranch(branchName string) void +pushBranch(branchName string) void +createPullRequest(version string, branchName string) Promise~void~ +showCompletion(version string, branchName string) void +extractVersionFromBranch(branchName string) string +main() Promise~void~ } class GitCLI { <> +execSync(command string, options any) string +execFileSync(file string, args string[], options any) void } class FileSystem { <> +readFileSync(path string, encoding string) string } class SemverLib { <> +parse(version string) any +inc(version string, releaseType string) string } class InquirerPrompts { <> +confirm(options any) Promise~boolean~ +input(options any) Promise~string~ } class ConsolaLogger { <> +info(message string) void +error(message string) void +success(message string) void +box(message string) void } HotfixWorkflow --> GitCLI : uses HotfixWorkflow --> FileSystem : reads package.json HotfixWorkflow --> SemverLib : uses for version bump HotfixWorkflow --> InquirerPrompts : prompts user HotfixWorkflow --> ConsolaLogger : logs output ``` #### Flow diagram for updated auto-tag and hotfix GitHub Action ```mermaid flowchart TD pr[PR opened against main] --> wf[auto-tag-release workflow starts] wf --> detect_release[Detect release PR from title] detect_release -->|is release PR| release_yes[Mark should_tag true with version] detect_release -->|not release PR| release_no[Mark should_tag false] release_no --> detect_hotfix[Detect hotfix PR from branch prefix] release_yes --> check_prepare_main detect_hotfix -->|head ref starts with hotfix/| hotfix_yes[Mark should_tag true] detect_hotfix -->|not hotfix branch| hotfix_no[Mark should_tag false] hotfix_yes --> resolve_hotfix_version[Resolve hotfix version from package.json] hotfix_no --> end_no_tag[No tagging, no release] resolve_hotfix_version --> set_context_hotfix[Set env context KIND hotfix and VERSION] release_yes --> set_context_release[Set env context KIND release and VERSION] set_context_release --> check_prepare_main set_context_hotfix --> check_prepare_main check_prepare_main[Prepare main branch checkout and pull] --> check_tag[Check if tag vVERSION exists] check_tag -->|tag exists| output_exists[Output result: tag already exists] check_tag -->|tag does not exist| bump_version[Bump package.json version and push to main] bump_version --> create_tag[Create annotated tag on bumped commit SHA] create_tag --> decide_release_type{KIND} decide_release_type -->|release| gh_release_release[Create GitHub Release for release] decide_release_type -->|hotfix| gh_release_hotfix[Create GitHub Release for hotfix] gh_release_release --> output_final gh_release_hotfix --> output_final output_exists --> output_final end_no_tag --> output_no_tag[Output: Not a release/hotfix PR] output_no_tag --> done output_final[Output final tagging result] --> done[Workflow end] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Extend auto-tag workflow to support hotfix PRs and tag the bumped-version commit on main. |
  • Rename the release detection step and introduce a separate hotfix detection step based on head branch prefix hotfix/*.
  • Introduce shared SHOULD_TAG/KIND/VERSION context via GITHUB_ENV and branch preparation step for both release and hotfix flows.
  • Add hotfix-version resolution using semver to compute a stable patch bump from package.json, even from pre-release versions.
  • Insert a bump-version step that updates package.json, commits with different messages for release vs hotfix, pushes to main, and exposes the SHA used for tagging.
  • Change tag creation to use the bumped-version commit SHA and adjust tag messages to include a hotfix or release prefix.
  • Split GitHub Release creation into separate steps for release and hotfix, with tailored titles and bodies, and update output messaging to cover both release and hotfix.
  • Make tag existence checks and result reporting use the shared env VERSION/SHOULD_TAG instead of step-local outputs.

  • Delete ENABLE_BUSINESS_FEATURES flag helper and associated logging.

  • Change git branch listing to use utf8 encoding instead of utf-8 for Node execSync.

  • Update main release workflow step to call the simplified createReleaseBranch function without version type.
| `scripts/releaseWorkflow/index.ts` | | Change release CI to verify package.json matches the tag instead of mutating it during release. |
  • Replace the step that rewrites and commits package.json with a Node-based check that fails if package.json.version differs from the tag.
  • Remove git config, commit, and push behavior from the release workflow, so releases assume version was already bumped.
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | | Add a dedicated hotfix workflow CLI script and npm script, and bump the UI dependency version. |
  • Introduce scripts/hotfixWorkflow/index.ts to guide hotfix creation: validate repo and branch, compute patch version (coercing pre-releases to stable), derive or extract hotfix branch names, confirm actions with the user, create/push hotfix branches, and open PRs via GitHub CLI with a standard title and body.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds full agent skill management and viewing capabilities, including backend support for listing skill resources with optional file content, APIs and services for downloading skill archives, store hooks and selectors for fetching skill details, and UI components/integrations to browse, inspect, edit, and manage agent skills alongside MCP plugins in the Skill Store and settings pages. #### Sequence diagram for viewing agent skill detail with resource content ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant AgentSkillItem participant AgentSkillDetail participant ToolStore participant AgentSkillsSlice participant AgentSkillService participant LambdaAgentSkillsRouter participant AgentSkillModel participant SkillResourceService participant FileService User->>AgentSkillItem: click skill title AgentSkillItem->>AgentSkillDetail: open detail modal with skillId AgentSkillDetail->>ToolStore: useFetchAgentSkillDetail(skillId) ToolStore->>AgentSkillsSlice: call useFetchAgentSkillDetail(skillId) AgentSkillsSlice->>AgentSkillService: getById(skillId) AgentSkillsSlice->>AgentSkillService: listResources(skillId, true) AgentSkillService->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: getById(id) LambdaAgentSkillsRouter->>AgentSkillModel: findById(id) AgentSkillModel-->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: SkillItem LambdaAgentSkillsRouter-->>AgentSkillService: SkillItem AgentSkillService->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: listResources(id, includeContent=true) LambdaAgentSkillsRouter->>AgentSkillModel: findById(id) AgentSkillModel-->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: SkillItem with resources LambdaAgentSkillsRouter->>SkillResourceService: listResources(resources, includeContent=true) SkillResourceService->>SkillResourceService: buildTree(paths) SkillResourceService->>SkillResourceService: populateContent(tree, resources) SkillResourceService->>FileService: getFileContentByHash(fileHash) for each text file FileService-->>SkillResourceService: file content SkillResourceService-->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: SkillResourceTreeNode[] with content LambdaAgentSkillsRouter-->>AgentSkillService: SkillResourceTreeNode[] with content AgentSkillService-->>AgentSkillsSlice: SkillItem and resourceTree AgentSkillsSlice->>ToolStore: update agentSkillDetailMap and return data ToolStore-->>AgentSkillDetail: {skillDetail, resourceTree} AgentSkillDetail->>AgentSkillDetail: buildContentMap(resourceTree) AgentSkillDetail->>FileTree: render file tree AgentSkillDetail->>ContentViewer: render content for selected file ``` #### Sequence diagram for downloading an agent skill zip archive ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant AgentSkillItem participant AgentSkillService participant LambdaAgentSkillsRouter participant AgentSkillModel participant FileModel participant FileService participant DownloadUtil User->>AgentSkillItem: click download AgentSkillItem->>AgentSkillService: getZipUrl(skill.id) AgentSkillService->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: getByIdWithZipUrl(id) LambdaAgentSkillsRouter->>AgentSkillModel: findById(id) AgentSkillModel-->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: SkillItem alt missing_skill LambdaAgentSkillsRouter-->>AgentSkillService: TRPCError NOT_FOUND else has_zip_hash LambdaAgentSkillsRouter->>FileModel: checkHash(zipFileHash) FileModel-->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: {isExist, url} alt file_missing_or_no_url LambdaAgentSkillsRouter-->>AgentSkillService: {name, url=null} else file_ok LambdaAgentSkillsRouter->>FileService: getFullFileUrl(url) FileService-->>LambdaAgentSkillsRouter: fullUrl or null LambdaAgentSkillsRouter-->>AgentSkillService: {name, url=fullUrl} end end AgentSkillService-->>AgentSkillItem: {name, url} alt url_available AgentSkillItem->>DownloadUtil: downloadFile(url, name.zip) DownloadUtil-->>User: browser starts zip download else no_url AgentSkillItem-->>User: no download (silently fails or shows message) end ``` #### Class diagram for agent skill backend, store, and UI structures ```mermaid classDiagram class SkillResourceTreeNode { +string name +string path +string type +SkillResourceTreeNode[] children +string content } class SkillResourceMeta { +string fileHash +number size } class SkillResourceService { -fileService FileService +listResources(resources Record_string_SkillResourceMeta, includeContent boolean) Promise_SkillResourceTreeNode_array -populateContent(nodes SkillResourceTreeNode_array, resources Record_string_SkillResourceMeta) Promise_void -buildTree(paths string_array) SkillResourceTreeNode_array } class FileService { +getFileContentByHash(fileHash string) Promise_string +getFullFileUrl(path string) Promise_string } class FileModel { +checkHash(fileHash string) Promise_FileInfo } class AgentSkillService { +getById(id string) Promise_SkillItem +getZipUrl(id string) Promise_ZipUrlResult +getByIdentifier(identifier string) Promise_SkillItem +listResources(id string, includeContent boolean) Promise_SkillResourceTreeNode_array +readResource(id string, path string) Promise_SkillResourceContent } class AgentSkillModel { +findById(id string) Promise_SkillItem } class agentSkillsRouter { +getById(input IdInput) SkillItem +getByIdWithZipUrl(input IdInput) ZipUrlResult +getByIdentifier(input IdentifierInput) SkillItem +listResources(input ListResourcesInput) SkillResourceTreeNode_array } class AgentSkillsState { +SkillListItem[] agentSkills +Record_string_SkillItem agentSkillDetailMap } class AgentSkillDetailData { +SkillResourceTreeNode[] resourceTree +SkillItem skillDetail } class AgentSkillsAction { +createAgentSkill(params CreateSkillInput) Promise_SkillItem +deleteAgentSkill(id string) Promise_void +importAgentSkillFromUrl(params ImportURLInput) Promise_SkillImportResult +importAgentSkillFromZip(params ImportZipInput) Promise_SkillImportResult +refreshAgentSkills() Promise_void +updateAgentSkill(params UpdateSkillInput) Promise_SkillItem +useFetchAgentSkillDetail(skillId string) SWRResponse_AgentSkillDetailData +useFetchAgentSkills(enabled boolean) SWRResponse_SkillListItem_array } class agentSkillsSelectors { +getAgentSkills(state ToolStoreState) SkillListItem_array +getMarketAgentSkills(state Git_cli-->>ActionsRunner: DIFF result ActionsRunner->>ActionsRunner: If DIFF is empty, exit job ActionsRunner->>Git_cli: git push origin SYNC_BRANCH_MAIN_CANARY -f ActionsRunner->>GitHubCLI: gh pr create base canary head SYNC_BRANCH_MAIN_CANARY GitHubCLI-->>PR: Create pull request main to canary PR-->>Developer: New sync PR visible in repository ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a new GitHub Actions workflow that syncs `main` into `canary` via an auto-created PR whenever `main` is updated. |

## Reviewer's Guide Adds new Zhipu models (glm-5, glm-4.6v variants, glm-image), wires up pricing/metadata, and adjusts the Zhipu provider payload handling to respect the caller’s stream flag while conditionally enabling tool_stream for supported models, along with minor metadata tweaks to existing models and removal of now-invalid tests. #### Sequence diagram for Zhipu chatCompletion payload with stream and tool_stream ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Caller participant ZhipuProvider participant ZhipuClient participant ZhipuAPI Caller->>ZhipuProvider: chat(payload with model, stream, tools, enabledSearch) ZhipuProvider->>ZhipuProvider: build zhipuTools from tools and enabledSearch ZhipuProvider->>ZhipuProvider: resolveParams based on model and payload alt model matches /^glm-(4.6|4.7|5)$/ and stream is true ZhipuProvider->>ZhipuClient: chat.completions.create({ model, stream: true, tool_stream: true, tools: zhipuTools, ...resolvedParams, ...rest }) else non matching model or stream is false ZhipuProvider->>ZhipuClient: chat.completions.create({ model, stream, tool_stream: undefined, tools: zhipuTools, ...resolvedParams, ...rest }) end ZhipuClient->>ZhipuAPI: HTTP POST /chat/completions ZhipuAPI-->>ZhipuClient: streamed response chunks ZhipuClient-->>ZhipuProvider: streamed completion ZhipuProvider-->>Caller: streamed completion ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Register new Zhipu chat models glm-5 and the glm-4.6V multimodal family with detailed pricing, capabilities, and metadata. |
  • Add glm-5 chat model definition including abilities, context window, pricing tiers (with cache read), extended params, and release date.
  • Add glm-4.6v, glm-4.6v-flashx, and glm-4.6v-flash multimodal chat model definitions with vision support, pricing tiers, and release metadata.

configuration from Browser/appBrowsers while wiring Tahoe detection through env and preload APIs with updated tests and native-deps config. #### Sequence diagram for Browser window creation with macOS Tahoe liquid glass ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant Browser participant WindowThemeManager participant BrowserWindow participant webContents participant liquidGlass User->>Browser: createBrowserWindow() Browser->>Browser: strip vibrancy visualEffectState transparent from options Browser->>WindowThemeManager: getPlatformConfig() WindowThemeManager-->>Browser: { WindowThemeManager->>liquidGlass: unstable_setVariant(liquidGlassViewId 2) ``` #### Class diagram for centralized window visual effects and liquid glass lifecycle ```mermaid classDiagram class WindowThemeManager { -identifier string -browserWindow BrowserWindow -listenerSetup boolean -boundHandleThemeChange function -liquidGlassViewId number +WindowThemeManager(identifier string) +attach(browserWindow BrowserWindow) void +cleanup() void +getPlatformConfig() any +applyVisualEffects() void +applyLiquidGlass() void -setupThemeListener() void -handleThemeChange() void uses WindowThemeManager ..> Env : reads_isMacTahoe ElectronApiPreload ..> Env : reads_os_release ElectronApiPreload --> Window : exposes_lobeEnv Window o-- darwinEnv ``` #### Flow diagram for macOS platform branching and visual effect selection ```mermaid flowchart LR Start["Start window creation"] --> CheckPlatform{Platform} CheckPlatform -->|Windows| WindowsPath CheckPlatform -->|macOS| CheckTahoe CheckPlatform -->|Other| OtherPath WindowsPath["Windows\nuse backgroundColor + titleBarOverlay"] --> ApplyWin["WindowThemeManager applyWindowsVisualEffects"] CheckTahoe{isMacTahoe and liquidGlass available} CheckTahoe -->|Yes| TahoePath CheckTahoe -->|No| PreTahoePath TahoePath["macOS Tahoe+\ntransparent window\nno vibrancy"] --> TahoeConfig["getPlatformConfig returns transparent true"] --> TahoeEffects["attach sets did-finish-load hook\napplyLiquidGlass after load"] PreTahoePath["macOS pre-Tahoe"] --> PreTahoeConfig["getPlatformConfig returns vibrancy sidebar\nvisualEffectState active"] --> PreTahoeEffects["Electron manages vibrancy natively"] OtherPath["Other platforms\nno special visual effects"] --> End["Window created"] ApplyWin --> End TahoeEffects --> End PreTahoeEffects --> End ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Centralize platform-specific visual effects in WindowThemeManager and add liquid glass lifecycle for macOS Tahoe. |
  • Lazily require electron-liquid-glass only on macOS Tahoe, guarding against missing native binaries.
  • Extend WindowThemeManager with liquidGlassViewId state, a useLiquidGlass getter, and cleanup logic to reset state on detach.
  • Update attach() to register a did-finish-load hook that applies liquid glass once the web contents are ready.

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/34cccf47c1d7baf714be528d84dc69e3b1362416/e2e/scripts/setup.ts#L282-L283 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Keep server probe specific before reusing existing process** `isServerRunning` now treats any HTTP status from `/` as success, so any process listening on the target port (including a non-LobeHub app returning 404/500) is considered a valid server. Because `startServer` exits early when this check passes, the E2E suite can run against the wrong service and produce misleading failures; this is especially likely in local/dev environments where ports are reused. The probe should validate an app-specific route/response instead of `status > 0`. --- https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/34cccf47c1d7baf714be528d84dc69e3b1362416/src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/ModelDetailPanel.tsx#L242-L243 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Fall back to raw model description when i18n key is missing** This branch checks `model.description` but renders only `tModels(`${model.id}.description`)`. For custom or remote model IDs without a matching entry in the `models` locale namespace, users will see the untranslated key (for example, `custom-model.description`) instead of the configured description text. Add a fallback to `model.description` when the translation is absent.

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/222c97423898e798c37052410166e7daf635e52e/src/features/ResourceManager/components/Explorer/SearchResultsOverlay.tsx#L187-L190 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Write search-result selections to resource manager store** The search overlay keeps row selection in a local `useState` array and updates only that local state in `onSelectedChange`, while the header/batch actions read `selectedFileIds` from `useResourceManagerStore`. In search mode this disconnect means checking files does not drive shared selection state, so multi-file actions can remain disabled or act on stale selection, and selections are lost when the overlay closes. --- https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/222c97423898e798c37052410166e7daf635e52e/src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/ModelDetailPanel.tsx#L243 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Fall back to raw model description when i18n key is absent** The detail panel renders descriptions via `tModels(`${model.id}.description`)` whenever `model.description` exists, but it never falls back to `model.description` itself. For provider/custom models that are not present in locale resources, this shows the untranslated key (for example `my-model.description`) instead of the actual metadata description, which regresses model-detail readability.

```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant EditorUI participant ReactImagePlugin participant ImageUploadHook as useImageUpload participant FileStore as useFileStore_uploadWithProgress showOpenDialog(filters) ElectronDialog-->>LocalFileCtr: { canceled, filePaths } alt User selects a file LocalFileCtr->>FileSystem: readFile(filePath) FileSystem-->>LocalFileCtr: data body:
## Reviewer's Guide Implements end-to-end support for discovering and installing LobeHub Market skills via new search and import-from-market flows, enhances URL-based imports to auto-handle ZIP vs SKILL.md (including resource and ZIP persistence), wires these through TRPC/lambda routes and client executors, and slightly relaxes skill manifest author typing for market compatibility. #### Sequence diagram for searching skills via LobeHub Market ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant SkillsExecutor participant SkillsExecutionRuntime participant SkillServerRuntimeService participant MarketService participant LobeHubMarketApi User->>SkillsExecutor: searchSkill(params, ctx) SkillsExecutor->>SkillsExecutor: check ctx.signal SkillsExecutor->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: searchSkill(params) SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: ensure service.searchSkill exists SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillServerRuntimeService: searchSkill(params) SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: log params SkillServerRuntimeService->>MarketService: searchSkill(params) MarketService->>MarketService: build query params and URL MarketService->>LobeHubMarketApi: HTTP GET /api/v1/skills LobeHubMarketApi-->>MarketService: JSON { items, page, pageSize, total } MarketService-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: { items, page, pageSize, total } SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: { items, page, pageSize, total } SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: format skills list and summary SkillsExecutionRuntime-->>SkillsExecutor: BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput SkillsExecutor-->>User: BuiltinToolResult with content and state ``` #### Sequence diagram for importing a skill from LobeHub Market ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant SkillsExecutor participant SkillsExecutionRuntime participant SkillServerRuntimeService participant MarketService participant SkillImporter participant FileService participant SkillModel participant SkillResourceService participant LobeHubMarketApi User->>SkillsExecutor: importFromMarket({ identifier }, ctx) SkillsExecutor->>SkillsExecutor: check ctx.signal SkillsExecutor->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: importFromMarket({ identifier }) SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: ensure service.importFromMarket exists SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillServerRuntimeService: importFromMarket(identifier) SkillServerRuntimeService->>MarketService: getSkillDownloadUrl(identifier) MarketService-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: downloadUrl SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: log downloadUrl SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillServerRuntimeService: importFromZipUrl(downloadUrl) SkillServerRuntimeService->>SkillImporter: importFromUrl({ url: downloadUrl }) SkillImporter->>LobeHubMarketApi: HTTP GET downloadUrl LobeHubMarketApi-->>SkillImporter: ZIP buffer SkillImporter->>SkillImporter: parseZipPackage(zipBuffer) -> manifest, content, zipHash, resources alt resources present SkillImporter->>SkillResourceService: storeResources(zipHash, resources) SkillResourceService-->>SkillImporter: resourceMap end SkillImporter->>FileService: uploadBuffer(zipKey, zipBuffer, application/zip) FileService-->>SkillImporter: ok SkillImporter->>FileService: createGlobalFile({ fileHash: zipHash, ... }) FileService-->>SkillImporter: ok alt existing skill SkillImporter->>SkillModel: update({ content, manifest, resources, zipFileHash }) SkillModel-->>SkillImporter: updatedSkill else new skill SkillImporter->>SkillModel: create({ content, manifest, resources, source, zipFileHash }) SkillModel-->>SkillImporter: createdSkill end SkillImporter-->>SkillServerRuntimeService: { skill, status } SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: { skill, status } SkillsExecutionRuntime->>SkillServerRuntimeService: onSkillImported() SkillServerRuntimeService-->>SkillsExecutionRuntime: refreshed SkillsExecutionRuntime-->>SkillsExecutor: BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput SkillsExecutor-->>User: BuiltinToolResult with install summary ``` #### Class diagram for updated skill and market runtime types ```mermaid classDiagram class SkillsApiName { } class SearchSkillParams { string locale string order number page number pageSize string search string sort } class MarketSkillItem { string category string createdAt string description number downloadCount string identifier string name string repository string sourceUrl string summary string updatedAt string version } class SearchSkillState { MarketSkillItem[] items number page number pageSize number total } class ImportFromMarketParams { string identifier } class ImportFromMarketState { string name string skillId string status bool success } class SkillRuntimeService { +execScript(command, options) Promise +exportFile(path, filename) Promise +findAll() Promise +findById(id) Promise +findByName(name) Promise +importFromGitHub(gitUrl) Promise +importFromMarket(identifier) Promise +importFromUrl(url) Promise +importFromZipUrl(url) Promise +onSkillImported() Promise +readResource(id, path) Promise +runCommand(options) Promise +searchSkill(params) Promise } class SkillsExecutionRuntime { -SkillRuntimeService service +searchSkill(params) BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput +importFromMarket(params) BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput } class MarketApiService { +searchSkill(params) Promise +getSkillDownloadUrl(identifier) string } class MarketService { +searchSkill(params) Promise +getSkillDetail(identifier) Promise +getSkillDownloadUrl(identifier) string } class SkillImporter { +importFromUrl(input) Promise } SkillsExecutionRuntime --> SkillRuntimeService : depends on MarketApiService --> MarketService : mirrors getSkillDownloadUrl SkillImporter --> MarketService : uses downloadUrl in agentSkills.importFromMarket ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add market skill search and detail support in the MarketService and MarketApiService, exposed via new TRPC market.skill router. |
  • Introduce MarketService.searchSkill, getSkillDetail, and getSkillDownloadUrl methods to call the market /skills API endpoints and format responses with logging and error handling.
  • Add MarketApiService.searchSkill and getSkillDownloadUrl to proxy skill search and download URL generation through the client lambda client.
  • Create a new TRPC market.skill router with a searchSkill query using marketProcedure, validating input via zod, instantiating MarketService from middleware context, and translating backend errors into TRPC errors.
  • Register the new skillRouter under marketRouter.skill for lambda routing.
| `src/server/services/market/index.ts`
`src/services/marketApi.ts`
`src/server/routers/lambda/market/skill.ts`
`src/server/routers/lambda/market/index.ts` | | Extend the skills execution runtime, executor, and manifest to support searching skills and importing skills directly from the market via server-side runtime. |
  • Expand SkillRuntimeService interface with optional searchSkill and importFromMarket methods plus stricter non-optional signatures for core operations.
