You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a new SQL migration to enable the pg_search extension and adjusts the PGlite test database setup to run migrations manually while skipping migrations that rely on unsupported pg_search/bm25 extensions. #### Sequence diagram for getTestDB with manual PGlite migrations ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor DevTest as Dev_or_CI_tests participant Env as Env participant getTestDB participant PGliteInstance as PGlite participant ServerDB as Postgres_server_DB participant Migrations as SQL_migrations_folder participant PgSearch as pg_search_extension DevTest->>getTestDB: call getTestDB getTestDB->>Env: read TEST_SERVER_DB alt Server DB mode Env-->>getTestDB: TEST_SERVER_DB=1 getTestDB->>ServerDB: connect and run migrations ServerDB->>PgSearch: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_search getTestDB-->>DevTest: LobeChatDatabase(ServerDB) else PGlite mode Env-->>getTestDB: TEST_SERVER_DB!=1 getTestDB->>PGliteInstance: create PGlite with extensions getTestDB->>PGliteInstance: initialize drizzle client getTestDB->>Migrations: list and sort .sql files loop each migration file getTestDB->>Migrations: read SQL getTestDB->>getTestDB: skip if contains pg_search or bm25 alt migration allowed getTestDB->>PGliteInstance: exec SQL else migration skipped getTestDB-->>getTestDB: do not exec end end getTestDB-->>DevTest: LobeChatDatabase(PGliteInstance) end ``` #### Flow diagram for pgliteMigrateManual migration execution ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Start pgliteMigrateManual] --> B[Read migrationsFolder] B --> C[Filter files ending with .sql] C --> D[Sort migration filenames] D --> E{More filenames?} E -->|No| F[End] E -->|Yes| G[Read next migration file] G --> H[Load SQL content] H --> I{Is SQL empty after trim?} I -->|Yes| E I -->|No| J{Contains pg_search or bm25?} J -->|Yes| E J -->|No| K[Execute SQL on PGlite] K --> E ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce manual migration runner for PGlite tests that skips pg_search/bm25-dependent migrations. |
  • Add pgliteMigrateManual helper that discovers and orders .sql migration files from the migrations folder.
  • Implement filtering logic to skip empty SQL files and any migration whose contents include pg_search or bm25 before executing via PGlite.
  • Update getTestDB to call the new manual migration helper instead of the default pgliteMigrate when running in PGlite mode.
| `packages/database/src/core/getTestDB.ts` | | Add database migration enabling the pg_search extension. |
  • Create new SQL migration 0089_enable_pg_search.sql that runs CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_search.
  • Register the new migration in the migrations metadata journal so it participates in standard migration workflows.
| `packages/database/migrations/0089_enable_pg_search.sql`
`packages/database/migrations/meta/_journal.json` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a custom SQL migration to enable the PostgreSQL pg_search extension, adjusts PGlite test migrations to skip unsupported pg_search/bm25 migrations, and updates internal release and migration documentation for database schema and versioning workflows. #### Flow diagram for PGlite manual migrations skipping pg_search and bm25 ```mermaid flowchart TD Start[Start PGlite test DB setup] --> InitPGlite[Create PGlite instance with vector extension] InitPGlite --> ListFiles[Read migrationsFolder and list *.sql files] ListFiles --> ForEachFile{For each migration file} ForEachFile --> ReadFile[Read SQL content] ReadFile --> IsEmpty{SQL is empty?} IsEmpty -- Yes --> NextFile[Skip file and continue] IsEmpty -- No --> CheckUnsupported{SQL contains pg_search or bm25?} CheckUnsupported -- Yes --> SkipUnsupported[Skip migration for PGlite] SkipUnsupported --> NextFile CheckUnsupported -- No --> ExecSQL[Execute SQL via pglite.exec] ExecSQL --> NextFile NextFile --> ForEachFile ForEachFile -->|No more files| Done[All supported migrations applied] Done --> ReadyDB[Return testClientDB as LobeChatDatabase] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce custom SQL migration to enable pg_search extension and corresponding meta snapshot entries. |
  • Add migration file that runs CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_search
  • Generate corresponding snapshot metadata for the new migration in the migrations meta directory
  • Update migration journal metadata to register the new migration and snapshot

  • Add helper that reads SQL migration files, filters out empty ones, and skips those containing pg_search or bm25 before executing against PGlite
  • Switch test DB initialization to call the new manual migration helper instead of the standard pgliteMigrate

  • Change DB schema migration release branching strategy from canary to main and require cherry-picking migration commits

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adds support for hashing API keys in the database and wires corresponding schema/relations changes, along with the migration metadata updates extracted from broader OpenAPI work. #### ER diagram for updated API key and message translation database schema ```mermaid erDiagram api_keys { uuid id PK varchar name varchar key varchar key_hash boolean enabled timestamptz expires_at timestamptz last_used_at } messages { uuid id PK uuid session_id varchar content } message_translates { uuid id PK uuid message_id varchar translated_content } messages ||--|| message_translates : translation ``` #### Class diagram for updated apiKeys schema and messages relations ```mermaid classDiagram class ApiKeysTable { +uuid id +varchar name +varchar key +varchar keyHash +boolean enabled +timestamptz expiresAt +timestamptz lastUsedAt } class MessagesTable { +uuid id +uuid sessionId +varchar content } class MessageTranslatesTable { +uuid id +uuid messageId +varchar translatedContent } class MessagesRelations { +messagesFiles filesToMessages +MessageTranslatesTable translation +SessionsTable session +ThreadsTable thread } ApiKeysTable <|.. apiKeysSchema class apiKeysSchema { +pgTable apiKeys } MessagesTable <|.. messagesSchema class messagesSchema { +pgTable messages } MessageTranslatesTable <|.. messageTranslatesSchema class messageTranslatesSchema { +pgTable messageTranslates } MessagesRelations --> MessagesTable : messages MessagesRelations --> MessageTranslatesTable : translation ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add database migration to support API key hashing and enforce uniqueness on the hash column. |

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Implements the missing desktop onboarding redirect in the user state redirect hook so that users who have not completed desktop onboarding are routed to /desktop-onboarding instead of silently continuing, restoring both the onboarding flow and the AuthRequiredModal behavior. #### Sequence diagram for desktop onboarding redirect and AuthRequiredModal behavior ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant DesktopApp participant useDesktopUserStateRedirect participant redirectIfNotOn participant Router participant AuthRequiredModal User->>DesktopApp: Launch app (initial load) DesktopApp->>useDesktopUserStateRedirect: invoke with state useDesktopUserStateRedirect->>useDesktopUserStateRedirect: getDesktopOnboardingCompleted() alt onboarding not completed useDesktopUserStateRedirect->>redirectIfNotOn: redirectIfNotOn(currentPath, /desktop-onboarding) redirectIfNotOn->>Router: navigate to /desktop-onboarding Router-->>User: Show desktop onboarding flow Note over AuthRequiredModal,Router: AuthRequiredModal not shown until onboarding is completed else onboarding completed useDesktopUserStateRedirect-->>DesktopApp: return without redirect DesktopApp->>Router: render main app routes alt 401 with X-Auth-Required true Router->>AuthRequiredModal: show modal AuthRequiredModal-->>User: Prompt for authentication end end ``` #### Flow diagram for useDesktopUserStateRedirect onboarding decision ```mermaid flowchart TD A[start useDesktopUserStateRedirect] --> B[getDesktopOnboardingCompleted] B --> C{onboarding completed?} C -- No --> D["call redirectIfNotOn(currentPath, /desktop-onboarding)"] D --> E[return] C -- Yes --> F[no redirect] F --> E E --> G[end hook invocation] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Implement desktop onboarding redirect when onboarding is not completed in the desktop user state redirect hook. |
  • Change the early-return guard to invoke redirectIfNotOn when desktop onboarding has not been completed
  • Redirect users from the current pathname to /desktop-onboarding if they have not completed onboarding
  • Preserve the existing hook structure and dependencies while removing the obsolete comment about a non-existent desktop-only onboarding flow

## Reviewer's Guide Implements a custom Drizzle migration flow for the PGlite-backed test database that skips pg_search/bm25 SQL while still recording migrations, and adds a new pg_search extension migration for real PostgreSQL environments. #### Sequence diagram for custom PGlite test migration flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Developer participant TestRunner participant getTestDB participant PGlite participant DrizzleTestClient Developer->>TestRunner: run tests TestRunner->>getTestDB: getTestDB() getTestDB->>PGlite: new PGlite(extensions: vector) getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: pgliteDrizzle(client, schema) getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: readMigrationFiles(migrationsFolder) getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: execute CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS drizzle getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: execute CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drizzle.__drizzle_migrations loop for each migration getTestDB->>getTestDB: compute skipSql based on pg_search/bm25 alt migration has no pg_search or bm25 loop for each stmt in migration.sql getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: execute stmt via sql.raw end else migration contains pg_search or bm25 getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: skip SQL execution end getTestDB->>DrizzleTestClient: INSERT INTO drizzle.__drizzle_migrations(hash, created_at) end getTestDB-->>TestRunner: return testClientDB TestRunner-->>Developer: tests run against migrated PGlite DB (without pg_search) ``` #### ER diagram for drizzle.__drizzle_migrations tracking table in tests ```mermaid erDiagram drizzle___drizzle_migrations { int id PK text hash bigint created_at } ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Replace the default PGlite migration helper with a custom migration runner that skips pg_search/bm25 statements but still applies all other migrations and records them in the Drizzle migrations table. |
  • Instantiate PGlite and Drizzle test client as before but bypass the pgliteMigrate helper
  • Read migration files using readMigrationFiles with the existing migrationsFolder
  • Ensure the drizzle schema and __drizzle_migrations table exist in the test database
  • Iterate over each migration, detect whether any SQL statement references pg_search or bm25, and conditionally skip executing those statements for incompatible migrations
  • For every migration, insert a row into drizzle.__drizzle_migrations with the migration hash and timestamp to keep migration tracking consistent
| `packages/database/src/core/getTestDB.ts` | | Add a new SQL migration to enable the pg_search extension in production/PostgreSQL and update migration metadata snapshots. |
  • Create migration 0090_enable_pg_search.sql that runs CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_search without wrapping in a DO/EXCEPTION block
  • Add or update the migrations meta journal (_journal.json) to include the new migration entry
  • Add 0090_snapshot.json to capture the schema state after enabling pg_search
| `packages/database/migrations/0090_enable_pg_search.sql`
`packages/database/migrations/meta/_journal.json`
`packages/database/migrations/meta/0090_snapshot.json` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a new SQL migration to enable the pg_search extension and introduces a custom migration runner for the test database that skips pg_search/BM25-related SQL for PGlite compatibility while still tracking migrations in Drizzle metadata tables. #### ER diagram for drizzle __drizzle_migrations tracking table ```mermaid erDiagram drizzle__drizzle_migrations { id int PK hash text created_at bigint } ``` #### Flow diagram for custom PGlite migration runner in getTestDB ```mermaid flowchart TD A_start[TestDB initialization in getTestDB] --> B_createPGlite[Create PGlite instance with vector extension] B_createPGlite --> C_createDrizzleClient[Create Drizzle client for testClientDB] C_createDrizzleClient --> D_readMigrations[Read migration files from migrationsFolder] D_readMigrations --> E_initDrizzleSchema[CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS drizzle] E_initDrizzleSchema --> F_initMigrationsTable[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drizzle.__drizzle_migrations] F_initMigrationsTable --> G_forEachMigration{For each migration} G_forEachMigration --> H_checkSkipSql[Check if any SQL contains pg_search or bm25] H_checkSkipSql --> I_skipBranch{skipSql?} I_skipBranch -- Yes --> L_insertMigrationRow[INSERT hash and folderMillis into drizzle.__drizzle_migrations] I_skipBranch -- No --> J_executeStatements[Execute each SQL statement via sql.raw] J_executeStatements --> L_insertMigrationRow L_insertMigrationRow --> M_nextOrFinish[Next migration or finish] M_nextOrFinish -->|More migrations| G_forEachMigration M_nextOrFinish -->|No more migrations| N_returnDB[Return testClientDB as LobeChatDatabase] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce custom migration runner for PGlite-based test database to skip pg_search/BM25 statements while still applying other migrations and recording them in Drizzle metadata. |
  • Replace generic pgliteMigrate invocation with manual migration execution using readMigrationFiles
  • Create drizzle schema and __drizzle_migrations table if they do not exist in the test database
  • Filter each migration to detect pg_search or bm25-related SQL and skip only those migrations while executing the remaining SQL statements

  • Register the new migration in migrations/meta/_journal.json
  • Add migrations/meta/0090_snapshot.json describing the schema snapshot after this migration

participant getTestDB participant PGliteInstance participant MigrationRunner participant DrizzleMigrationsTable Developer->>TestRunner: run tests TestRunner->>getTestDB: request test database getTestDB->>PGliteInstance: create PGlite with vector extension getTestDB->>MigrationRunner: readMigrationFiles(migrationsFolder) getTestDB->>PGliteInstance: execute CREATE SCHEMA drizzle getTestDB->>PGliteInstance: execute CREATE TABLE drizzle.__drizzle_migrations loop for each migration MigrationRunner->>MigrationRunner: compute skipSql by scanning SQL for pg_search or bm25 alt migration does not reference pg_search or bm25 loop for each SQL statement MigrationRunner->>PGliteInstance: execute sql.raw(stmt) end else migration references pg_search or bm25 MigrationRunner->>PGliteInstance: do not execute SQL end MigrationRunner->>DrizzleMigrationsTable: insert (hash, created_at) end getTestDB-->>TestRunner: return configured LobeChatDatabase ``` #### SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS drizzle"] C --> D["Execute CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drizzle.__drizzle_migrations"] D --> E["Iterate over migrations"] E --> F["For current migration, scan SQL statements for return LobeChatDatabase"] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a pg_search-enabling migration while keeping PGlite-based tests compatible by ## Reviewer's Guide Adds three new aihubmix "Claude * Think" chat model definitions that are configured to use the built-in Anthropic-style routing and extended parameters, including pricing, capabilities, and context settings. #### Class diagram for new aihubmix Claude Think model definitions ```mermaid classDiagram class AIChatModelCard { +abilities_functionCall bool +abilities_reasoning bool +abilities_search bool +abilities_structuredOutput bool +abilities_vision bool +contextWindowTokens number +description string +displayName string +id string +maxOutput number +releasedAt string +type string } class Pricing { +units Unit[] } class Unit { +name string +rate number +strategy string +unit string +lookup Lookup } class Lookup { +prices map +pricingParams string[] } class Settings { +extendParams string[] +searchImpl string } AIChatModelCard *-- Pricing Pricing *-- Unit Unit *-- Lookup AIChatModelCard *-- Settings class Claude_Opus_4_6_Think { +contextWindowTokens 200000 +maxOutput 128000 +releasedAt 2026_02_05 +extendParams disableContextCaching +extendParams reasoningBudgetToken +extendParams effort +searchImpl params } class Claude_Sonnet_4_6_Think { +contextWindowTokens 200000 +maxOutput 64000 +releasedAt 2026_02_17 +extendParams disableContextCaching +extendParams reasoningBudgetToken +extendParams effort +searchImpl params } class Claude_Sonnet_4_5_Think { +contextWindowTokens 200000 +maxOutput 64000 +releasedAt 2025_09_29 +extendParams disableContextCaching +extendParams reasoningBudgetToken +searchImpl params } Claude_Opus_4_6_Think --|> AIChatModelCard Claude_Sonnet_4_6_Think --|> AIChatModelCard Claude_Sonnet_4_5_Think --|> AIChatModelCard ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce three new aihubmix Claude Think chat models that align with Anthropic routing and capabilities to avoid parameter incompatibility issues. |
  • Add `claude-opus-4-6-think` model card with reasoning abilities, extended parameters, Anthropic-style pricing, and large context window/output limits.
  • Add `claude-sonnet-4-6-think` model card with similar capabilities and pricing tuned for the Sonnet tier, including cache read/write pricing and reasoning settings.
  • Add `claude-sonnet-4-5-think` model card with matching abilities, Sonnet 4.5-specific pricing, and extended parameter configuration for reasoning and context caching.

## Reviewer's Guide Unifies Canary desktop builds with the stable app’s name/icon while exposing a build-time channel over IPC so the Settings > About page can label non-stable builds (Canary/Nightly/Beta) beside the version, plus wiring for Electron icon selection and i18n strings. #### Sequence diagram for fetching and displaying desktop build channel in Settings About ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant VersionComponent as Version participant AutoUpdateService participant ElectronAutoUpdateIPC as ElectronAutoUpdate participant UpdaterCtr participant UpdaterConfigs as UpdaterConfigs User->>VersionComponent: Open Settings About activate VersionComponent VersionComponent->>VersionComponent: useEffect isDesktop check alt isDesktop is true VersionComponent->>AutoUpdateService: getBuildChannel() activate AutoUpdateService AutoUpdateService->>ElectronAutoUpdateIPC: getBuildChannel() activate ElectronAutoUpdateIPC ElectronAutoUpdateIPC->>UpdaterCtr: getBuildChannel() activate UpdaterCtr UpdaterCtr->>UpdaterConfigs: import BUILD_CHANNEL activate UpdaterConfigs UpdaterConfigs-->>UpdaterCtr: BUILD_CHANNEL deactivate UpdaterConfigs UpdaterCtr-->>ElectronAutoUpdateIPC: BUILD_CHANNEL deactivate UpdaterCtr ElectronAutoUpdateIPC-->>AutoUpdateService: BUILD_CHANNEL deactivate ElectronAutoUpdateIPC AutoUpdateService-->>VersionComponent: BUILD_CHANNEL deactivate AutoUpdateService VersionComponent->>VersionComponent: setBuildChannel(BUILD_CHANNEL) VersionComponent->>VersionComponent: render version Tag alt buildChannel is non stable VersionComponent->>VersionComponent: render channel Tag using i18n setting tab beta updateChannel end else isDesktop is false VersionComponent->>VersionComponent: skip buildChannel fetch end deactivate VersionComponent ``` #### Class diagram for updated updater IPC and Settings About version display ```mermaid classDiagram class Version { <> -mobile boolean -updaterState UpdaterState -buildChannel string -isDesktop boolean +render() } class AutoUpdateService { +getUpdateChannel() Promise~UpdateChannel~ +getBuildChannel() Promise~string~ +setUpdateChannel(channel UpdateChannel) Promise~void~ } class UpdaterCtr { <> +getUpdateChannel() Promise~UpdateChannel~ +getBuildChannel() Promise~string~ +setUpdateChannel(channel UpdateChannel) Promise~void~ } class UpdaterConfigs { <> +BUILD_CHANNEL string +UPDATE_CHANNEL UpdateChannel } Version --> AutoUpdateService : uses AutoUpdateService --> UpdaterCtr : IPC autoUpdate UpdaterCtr --> UpdaterConfigs : imports ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Show desktop build channel tag next to the app version on the Settings > About page for non-stable builds. |
  • Extend i18n hook in the About Version component to load both common and setting namespaces.
  • Track buildChannel in component state, fetching it via autoUpdateService when running in desktop.
  • Render a gold Tag with the localized buildChannel label when the buildChannel is defined and not stable, falling back to a capitalized raw value if no translation exists.
| `src/routes/(main)/settings/about/features/Version.tsx` | | Expose build-time update channel from the desktop main process over IPC and surface it through the renderer auto-update service. |
  • Add BUILD_CHANNEL export in updater configs that reflects the raw build-time UPDATE_CHANNEL without validation, including beta.
  • Add getBuildChannel IpcMethod on UpdaterCtr that imports BUILD_CHANNEL from the updater configs and returns it.
  • Add getBuildChannel wrapper method to the renderer AutoUpdateService that calls the new IPC method.
| `apps/desktop/src/main/modules/updater/configs.ts`
`apps/desktop/src/main/controllers/UpdaterCtr.ts`
`src/services/electron/autoUpdate.ts` | | Make Canary desktop builds share the same product name and icon as stable while keeping package identity distinct. |
  • Update the setDesktopVersion script so the canary channel uses productName 'LobeHub' but keeps a distinct package name 'lobehub-desktop-canary', and adjust logging to describe the identical appearance.
  • Adjust electron-builder icon selection so both stable and canary use the standard Icon, while nightly uses the pre-release Icon-nightly.
| `scripts/electronWorkflow/setDesktopVersion.ts`
`apps/desktop/electron-builder.mjs` | | Add localization for beta build channel labels in settings. |
  • Add setting tab.beta.updateChannel.beta translation key for the default locale to label the beta channel in the About tag.
  • (Partial) Update of zh-CN settings locale file to accommodate the new key, if needed.
| `src/locales/default/setting.ts`
`locales/zh-CN/setting.json` | ---

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide This PR ensures tool execution state is surfaced to the AI model by appending serialized state/pluginState into tool message content in both single-tool and batched tool executors, enabling multi-step workflows to reference previously created resource IDs. #### Sequence diagram for call_tool executor including state in AI model context ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant AgentRuntime participant ToolExecutor participant AIModel User->>AgentRuntime: Send request requiring tool AgentRuntime->>ToolExecutor: call_tool(chatToolPayload) ToolExecutor-->>AgentRuntime: executionResult(content, state) AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: Clone state into newState AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: Build modelContent = executionResult.content AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: If executionResult.state not empty AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: Append "\n\n" + JSON.stringify(executionResult.state) to modelContent AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: newState.messages.push({ role: tool, content: modelContent, tool_call_id }) AgentRuntime->>AIModel: Send messages including tool message with appended state in content AIModel-->>AgentRuntime: Continue multi-step workflow using resource IDs from tool state AgentRuntime-->>User: Return updated response ``` #### Sequence diagram for call_tools_batch executor appending pluginState to tool messages ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant AgentRuntime participant Database participant ParseFunction participant AIModel AgentRuntime->>Database: Load latestMessages from storage Database-->>AgentRuntime: latestMessages AgentRuntime->>ParseFunction: parse(latestMessages) ParseFunction-->>AgentRuntime: flatList (linearized messages) AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: Map over flatList AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: For each msg AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: If msg.role == tool and msg.pluginState not empty AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: Set msg.content = msg.content + "\n\n" + JSON.stringify(msg.pluginState) AgentRuntime->>AgentRuntime: Assign newState.messages = transformed list AgentRuntime->>AIModel: Send newState.messages to model AIModel-->>AgentRuntime: Use appended pluginState in content for follow-up tool calls ``` #### Flow diagram for transforming tool messages with state and pluginState ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Tool execution produces executionResult with content and state] --> B[Build modelContent from executionResult.content] B --> C{executionResult.state is non empty?} C -->|Yes| D[Append JSON stringified state to modelContent with line breaks] C -->|No| E[Keep modelContent unchanged] D --> F[Push tool message with modelContent into newState.messages] E --> F[Push tool message with modelContent into newState.messages] G[Load latestMessages from database] --> H[Parse latestMessages to flatList] H --> I[Map over flatList messages] I --> J{msg.role is tool and msg.pluginState is non empty?} J -->|Yes| K[Set msg.content to msg.content plus JSON stringified pluginState with line breaks] J -->|No| L[Leave msg.content unchanged] K --> M[Collect transformed messages into newState.messages] L --> M[Collect transformed messages into newState.messages] F --> N[Send newState.messages to AIModel] M --> N[Send newState.messages to AIModel] N --> O[AI model reads resource IDs from tool message content for multi step workflows] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Include tool execution state in tool messages sent to the AI model for single tool calls. |
  • Clone the existing runtime state before mutation in the call_tool executor.
  • Build a modelContent string starting from executionResult.content and append JSON-serialized executionResult.state when it is non-empty.
  • Push a new tool-role message using modelContent as content while leaving database-stored content unchanged.
| `src/server/modules/AgentRuntime/RuntimeExecutors.ts` | | Hydrate pluginState into tool message content when rebuilding message history for batched tool calls. |
  • After parsing latestMessages into a flatList, map over messages instead of assigning directly.
  • For tool-role messages with a non-empty pluginState, return a new message object with content extended by a JSON stringified pluginState (separated by blank lines).
  • Leave non-tool messages and tool messages without pluginState unchanged while still logging total refreshed messages.
| `src/server/modules/AgentRuntime/RuntimeExecutors.ts` | ### Assessment against linked issues | Issue | Objective | Addressed | Explanation | | ------ | ------- | ----- | ----- | | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/issues/12558 | Ensure tool return state (e.g., document/plan IDs in executionResult.state/pluginState) is included in tool messages sent to the AI model so multi-step workflows can access these IDs. | ✅ | | | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/issues/12558 | Apply this inclusion of tool state to both single tool executions and batched/tool-orchestrated executions without altering what is stored in the database. | ✅ | | ### Possibly linked issues - **#12558**: PR changes runtime executors to append tool state/pluginState to tool message content, fixing missing IDs in model context.

## Reviewer's Guide This PR prevents a crash in the ModelSelect dropdown by disabling the info tag rendering inside the Select popup, updates the default Anthropic model to Claude Sonnet 4.6 while marking older Anthropic models as non-default (not explicitly enabled), and adds tests to guard that the configured default models always exist and are enabled in the default model list. #### Sequence diagram for preventing ModelSelect crash in dropdown ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ModelSelect participant BaseUISelect participant ModelItemRender participant ModelInfoTags User->>ModelSelect: Click model dropdown ModelSelect->>BaseUISelect: Render Select with optionRender BaseUISelect->>ModelItemRender: Render option showInfoTag=false ModelItemRender--x ModelInfoTags: Skip rendering ModelInfoTags Note over ModelSelect,BaseUISelect: Removing ModelInfoTags prevents forkRef cleanup loop ``` #### Class diagram for updated AI model configuration and ModelSelect rendering ```mermaid classDiagram class AiModelService { +getDefaultModel() string +getDefaultMiniModel() string +getDefaultModelList() AIChatModelCard[] } class AIChatModelCard { +string id +string providerId +string displayName +string description +number contextWindowTokens +number maxOutput +boolean enabled } class LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST { <> +AIChatModelCard[] values } class SettingsConstants { <> +string DEFAULT_MODEL +string DEFAULT_MINI_MODEL +string DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL } class ModelSelect { <> +render() -optionRender(option ModelOption) ReactNode } class ModelItemRender { <> +boolean showInfoTag +render() } class ModelOption { +string id +string provider +string displayName +boolean vision +boolean reasoning } %% Updated default model constants SettingsConstants : DEFAULT_MODEL = claude-sonnet-4-6 SettingsConstants : DEFAULT_MINI_MODEL = gpt-5-mini %% Relationships AiModelService --> LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST : uses AiModelService --> SettingsConstants : reads LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST --> AIChatModelCard : contains ModelSelect --> ModelItemRender : renders ModelSelect --> ModelOption : consumes ModelItemRender --> ModelOption : props %% Legacy models no longer forced enabled class ClaudeSonnet45Card { <> +string id = claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 +string displayName = Claude Sonnet 4.5 +boolean enabled } class ClaudeOpus45Card { <> +string id = claude-opus-4-5-20251101 +string displayName = Claude Opus 4.5 +boolean enabled } AIChatModelCard <|-- ClaudeSonnet45Card AIChatModelCard <|-- ClaudeOpus45Card %% ModelSelect rendering change ModelItemRender : showInfoTag=false in Select popup ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add tests to ensure configured default models exist and are enabled in the default model list. |
  • Introduce a new test suite validating that DEFAULT_MODEL exists in LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST and has enabled set to true.
  • Introduce a similar test ensuring DEFAULT_MINI_MODEL exists in LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST and is enabled.
| `src/services/aiModel/index.test.ts` | | Update the global default chat model to Claude Sonnet 4.6. |
  • Change DEFAULT_MODEL constant value from claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 to claude-sonnet-4-6.
| `packages/const/src/settings/llm.ts` | | Mark legacy Anthropic models as non-enabled to steer usage away from them. |
  • Remove enabled: true from the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model definition in the Anthropic chat model list.
  • Remove enabled: true from the Claude Opus 4.5 model definition in the Anthropic chat model list.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/chat/anthropic.ts` | | Fix ModelSelect crash caused by rendering info tags inside the Select popup. |
  • Disable info tag rendering in the ModelSelect option renderer by passing showInfoTag={false} to ModelItemRender, avoiding the forkRef cleanup infinite update loop in the Select popup.
| `src/features/ModelSelect/index.tsx` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#N/A**: PR sets showInfoTag={false} in ModelSelect, directly fixing the onboarding dropdown crash described in the issue. - **#13254**: PR disables info tags in ModelSelect options, preventing the onboarding default model dropdown crash described in issue. ---

body:
Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Preloads the default en-US i18n resources synchronously during i18next initialization to prevent useTranslation from suspending on the first render, eliminating the initial layout shift while keeping non-default languages loaded asynchronously. #### Sequence diagram for i18n initialization with preloaded default resources ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant BrowserApp participant I18next participant ResourcesBackend User->>BrowserApp: LoadApp BrowserApp->>I18next: createI18nNext() I18next->>I18next: init({ resources: { DEFAULT_LANG: defaultResources } }) note over I18next: defaultResources = { chat, common, error } BrowserApp->>I18next: useTranslation(common) alt default language DEFAULT_LANG I18next-->>BrowserApp: Return translations from defaultResources BrowserApp-->>User: RenderHeader without Suspense else non default language I18next->>ResourcesBackend: Load namespace via resourcesToBackend ResourcesBackend-->>I18next: Async translations I18next-->>BrowserApp: Resolve translations BrowserApp-->>User: Render with selected language end ``` #### Flow diagram for language resource loading decision after preload change ```mermaid flowchart TD Start([App start]) --> InitI18n[Initialize i18next] InitI18n --> SetResources[Set resources for DEFAULT_LANG using defaultResources] SetResources --> Render[Component calls useTranslation] Render --> CheckLang{Requested language == DEFAULT_LANG} CheckLang -- Yes --> UsePreloaded[Use preloaded defaultResources] UsePreloaded --> NoSuspense[Return translations synchronously] NoSuspense --> Paint[Render UI without Suspense or layout shift] CheckLang -- No --> LoadAsync[Load language namespaces via resourcesToBackend] LoadAsync --> Suspense[useTranslation may suspend] Suspense --> PaintAsync[Render UI after async resources load] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Preload default language translation resources synchronously in i18n initialization to avoid Suspense on first render. |
  • Define a defaultResources object bundling chat, common, and error namespaces for the default language.
  • Pass the defaultResources into the i18next init options under resources keyed by DEFAULT_LANG.
  • Document via comment that this synchronous preload is intended to avoid Suspense on initial render while leaving other behavior unchanged.
| `src/locales/create.ts` |

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Documents a new TypeScript guideline requiring errors to be logged in `.catch()` callbacks instead of being silently swallowed, to improve production debugging. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add a logging requirement for errors handled in `.catch()` callbacks in the TypeScript skill guide. |
  • Extend the error logging bullet list with a rule that `.catch()` callbacks must log the error instead of using silent handlers like `.catch(() => fallback)`.
  • Clarify that silent catches hide failures and hinder debugging in production.
| `.agents/skills/typescript/SKILL.md` |
---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/81e8b997401b58ff6d109c1c293b54232a235a80/apps/cli/src/commands/search.ts#L239 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Read crawlPages payload from `results` before rendering** The `tools.search.crawlPages` endpoint returns an object with a `results` array, but this code treats the whole response as a page (or page array). In the normal non-JSON path (`lh search view `), successful crawls will render as `Untitled` with empty content because `p.title/p.url/p.content` are read from the wrapper object instead of each crawled result item. --- https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/blob/81e8b997401b58ff6d109c1c293b54232a235a80/src/envs/file.ts#L41 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Keep `S3_SET_ACL` default behavior backward compatible** This change flips `S3_SET_ACL` from default-on to default-off. With an unset or empty env var (which is a common/default container configuration), uploads stop setting `public-read`, changing object accessibility semantics and forcing non-public URL handling unless operators explicitly add `S3_SET_ACL=1`. That is a breaking runtime behavior change for existing S3 deployments that relied on the previous default.

[Your team has set up Codex to review pull requests in this repo](http://chatgpt.com/codex/settings/general). Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adds a new Jest unit test suite for MarketService and its helper extractAccessToken, heavily mocking external dependencies to cover constructor behavior, factory creation, feedback submission, skill execution, manifest retrieval, and error handling branches. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add comprehensive unit tests for MarketService and related helper covering normal flows, edge cases, and error paths while mocking external services. |
  • Create a new Jest test file that imports MarketService and extractAccessToken from the market service module.
  • Mock @lobehub/market-sdk and trusted client-related utilities to isolate MarketService logic from external APIs.
  • Add tests for extractAccessToken to validate correct handling of Bearer tokens, missing/invalid headers, and non-Bearer schemes.
  • Add tests for the MarketService constructor and createFromRequest factory to verify option precedence, access token sourcing from request and session, and handling of absent credentials.
  • Add tests for submitFeedback to confirm correct parameter mapping, inclusion/omission of optional screenshot URL, and interaction with the mocked SDK client.
  • Add tests for executeLobehubSkill to cover successful execution, request serialization, and error propagation or wrapping from the SDK.
  • Add tests for getLobehubSkillManifests to verify manifest construction, behavior with empty or malformed connections, missing providerId, listTools failures, and network error handling.
  • Add tests for getSDK to ensure it returns the underlying mocked SDK instance or behaves correctly when uninitialized.
| `src/server/services/market/index.test.ts` |

## Reviewer's Guide Introduces a Conversation-level HotkeyRegistry component that wires conversation store actions into hotkey callbacks, and mounts it inside ConversationProvider so conversation-specific keyboard shortcuts work with local message state. #### Sequence diagram for conversation hotkey handling ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant HotkeySystem participant HotkeyRegistry participant ConversationStore participant UIChat User->>HotkeySystem: keyDown RegenerateMessage HotkeySystem->>HotkeyRegistry: invoke RegenerateMessage callback HotkeyRegistry->>ConversationStore: get displayMessages HotkeyRegistry->>HotkeyRegistry: getLastAssistantMessageId(displayMessages) HotkeyRegistry->>ConversationStore: regenerateAssistantMessage(messageId) ConversationStore-->>UIChat: update displayMessages UIChat-->>User: show regenerated assistant message ``` #### Class diagram for ConversationProvider and HotkeyRegistry ```mermaid classDiagram class ConversationProvider { +children ReactNode +ConversationProvider(props) } class HotkeyRegistry { +HotkeyRegistry() } class ConversationStore { +deleteMessage(id) +delAndRegenerateMessage(id) +regenerateAssistantMessage(id) +displayMessages UIChatMessage[] } class UIChatMessage { +id string +role string } class HotkeyEnum { <> RegenerateMessage DeleteLastMessage DeleteAndRegenerateMessage } class useHotkeyById { +useHotkeyById(hotkeyId, callback, options, deps) } class useConversationStore { +useConversationStore(selector) } ConversationProvider *-- HotkeyRegistry HotkeyRegistry ..> useConversationStore HotkeyRegistry ..> useHotkeyById HotkeyRegistry ..> ConversationStore HotkeyRegistry ..> HotkeyEnum ConversationStore o-- UIChatMessage ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add a Conversation-level hotkey registry component that binds hotkey IDs to conversation store actions. |
  • Create a memoized HotkeyRegistry React component that registers conversation-specific hotkeys using useHotkeyById
  • Wire conversation store actions (delete, delete+regenerate, regenerate) and displayMessages into the registry via useConversationStore selector
  • Implement helper functions to locate the last assistant message and the last message in the display list for use by hotkey callbacks
  • Ensure hotkey callbacks are content-editable aware and include relevant dependencies for proper re-registration
| `src/features/Conversation/HotkeyRegistry.tsx` | | Mount the HotkeyRegistry within the ConversationProvider so it has access to the ConversationStore context. |
  • Render HotkeyRegistry inside ConversationProvider alongside ConversationPanel and children so it participates in the same provider scope
| `src/features/Conversation/ConversationProvider.tsx` | ### Assessment against linked issues | Issue | Objective | Addressed | Explanation | | ------ | ------- | ----- | ----- | | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/issues/11138 | Restore the non-working conversation-level keyboard shortcuts (e.g., regenerate message, delete last message, delete-and-regenerate) in the web client so they function correctly in the browser. | ✅ | | ### Possibly linked issues - **#unknown**: 该 PR 为会话消息相关快捷键提供注册逻辑，直接修复浏览器端部分快捷键失效的问题。 ---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts the tools engine to require explicit enablement with user-selected and always-on built‑in tools, and updates chat input loading behavior so the input stays disabled from send initiation through all relevant operations, adding tests and wiring across client and server code. #### Sequence diagram for chat input send and loading lifecycle ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ChatInput participant ConversationStore participant ChatStore participant OperationSelectors User->>ChatInput: Type message ChatInput->>ConversationStore: read isInputLoading ConversationStore-->>ChatInput: isInputLoading = false User->>ChatInput: Click send ChatInput->>ConversationStore: read isInputLoading ConversationStore-->>ChatInput: isInputLoading = false ChatInput->>ChatInput: check input not empty and files not uploading ChatInput->>ConversationStore: sendMessage(message, files, context) ConversationStore->>ChatStore: create sendMessage operation (status=running) ChatStore->>ChatStore: add operation type=sendMessage ChatInput->>ConversationStore: subscribe operationState ConversationStore->>ChatStore: read state with context ChatStore->>OperationSelectors: isInputLoadingByContext(context) OperationSelectors-->>ChatStore: true (sendMessage running) ChatStore-->>ConversationStore: operationState.isInputLoading = true ConversationStore-->>ChatInput: isInputLoading = true ChatInput->>ChatInput: disable input and show loading ChatStore->>ChatStore: run AI runtime operations ChatStore->>ChatStore: complete sendMessage and AI operations ChatInput->>ConversationStore: subscribe updated operationState ConversationStore->>ChatStore: read state with context ChatStore->>OperationSelectors: isInputLoadingByContext(context) OperationSelectors-->>ChatStore: false (no running operations) ChatStore-->>ConversationStore: operationState.isInputLoading = false ConversationStore-->>ChatInput: isInputLoading = false ChatInput->>ChatInput: enable input and hide loading User->>ChatInput: Optional stop generation ChatInput->>ConversationStore: stopGenerating() ConversationStore->>ChatStore: cancelOperations(filter INPUT_LOADING_OPERATION_TYPES) ChatStore->>ChatStore: cancel sendMessage and AI operations ConversationStore->>ChatStore: cancelSendMessageInServer(topicId) ``` #### Class diagram for updated operation loading state and selectors ```mermaid classDiagram class OperationState { +boolean isAIGenerating +boolean isInputLoading +string sendMessageError +getMessageOperationState() +getToolOperationState() } class DEFAULT_OPERATION_STATE { +boolean isAIGenerating = false +boolean isInputLoading = false +string sendMessageError +getMessageOperationState() +getToolOperationState() } class OperationSelectorContext { +string agentId +string groupId +string threadId +string topicId } class Operation { +string id +OperationType type +string status +OperationContext context +OperationMetadata metadata } class OperationContext { +string agentId +string groupId +string threadId +string topicId } class OperationMetadata { +boolean isAborting } class ChatStoreState { +map operations +map operationsByContext } class OperationSelectors { +isAgentRuntimeRunningByContext(context OperationSelectorContext) boolean +isInputLoadingByContext(context OperationSelectorContext) boolean } class AI_RUNTIME_OPERATION_TYPES { +OperationType[] types } class INPUT_LOADING_OPERATION_TYPES { +OperationType[] types } class OperationType { <> sendMessage execAgentRuntime execServerAgentRuntime } class ConversationContext { +string agentId +string groupId +string threadId +string topicId } class OperationStateHook { +useOperationState(context ConversationContext) OperationState } OperationState <|-- DEFAULT_OPERATION_STATE OperationSelectors --> ChatStoreState OperationSelectors --> Operation OperationSelectors --> OperationSelectorContext OperationSelectors --> INPUT_LOADING_OPERATION_TYPES INPUT_LOADING_OPERATION_TYPES --> AI_RUNTIME_OPERATION_TYPES Operation --> OperationContext Operation --> OperationMetadata OperationStateHook --> OperationSelectors OperationStateHook --> OperationState ConversationContext --> OperationSelectorContext ``` #### Class diagram for updated tools engine enablement ```mermaid classDiagram class ToolsEngineConfig { +string[] defaultToolIds +PluginEnableChecker enableChecker +InstalledPluginResolver getInstalledPluginById } class ToolsEngine { +ToolsEngineConfig config +generateToolsDetailed(params ToolsRequestParams) ToolsDetailed } class EnableCheckerConfig { +string[] whitelist +string[] blacklist +Record~string, boolean~ rules } class PluginEnableChecker { <> +isEnabled(pluginId string) boolean } class createEnableChecker { +createEnableChecker(config EnableCheckerConfig) PluginEnableChecker } class createToolsEngineFunction { +createToolsEngine(config ToolsEngineConfig) ToolsEngine } class WorkingModel { +string model +string provider } class AgentState { } class AgentConfig { +string[] plugins } class createAgentToolsEngineFunction { +createAgentToolsEngine(workingModel WorkingModel) ToolsEngine } class createServerAgentToolsEngineFunction { +createServerAgentToolsEngine(agentConfig AgentConfig) ToolsEngine } class defaultToolIds { +string[] ids } class alwaysOnToolIds { +string[] ids } class getAgentStoreStateFunction { +getAgentStoreState() AgentState } class agentSelectors { +currentAgentPlugins(agentState AgentState) string[] +hasEnabledKnowledgeBases(agentState AgentState) boolean } class agentChatConfigSelectors { +isMemoryToolEnabled(agentState AgentState) boolean } class getSearchConfigFunction { +getSearchConfig(model string, provider string) SearchConfig } class SearchConfig { +boolean useApplicationBuiltinSearchTool } class KnowledgeBaseManifest { +string identifier } class MemoryManifest { +string identifier } class WebBrowsingManifest { +string identifier } class LocalSystemManifest { +string identifier } class LobeToolsManifest { +string identifier } class SkillsManifest { +string identifier } createToolsEngineFunction --> ToolsEngine ToolsEngine --> ToolsEngineConfig createEnableChecker --> PluginEnableChecker PluginEnableChecker <.. ToolsEngineConfig createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> createToolsEngineFunction createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> getAgentStoreStateFunction createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> getSearchConfigFunction createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> agentSelectors createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> agentChatConfigSelectors createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> defaultToolIds createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> alwaysOnToolIds createAgentToolsEngineFunction --> createEnableChecker createServerAgentToolsEngineFunction --> createToolsEngineFunction createServerAgentToolsEngineFunction --> createEnableChecker createServerAgentToolsEngineFunction --> alwaysOnToolIds createServerAgentToolsEngineFunction --> KnowledgeBaseManifest createServerAgentToolsEngineFunction --> LocalSystemManifest defaultToolIds --> LobeToolsManifest defaultToolIds --> SkillsManifest alwaysOnToolIds --> LobeToolsManifest alwaysOnToolIds --> SkillsManifest agentSelectors --> KnowledgeBaseManifest agentChatConfigSelectors --> MemoryManifest getSearchConfigFunction --> WebBrowsingManifest ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce explicit enablement rules for tools, including always-on built-ins and user-selected plugins, and update the enable checker’s default behavior. |
  • Change createEnableChecker so tools are disabled by default when no rule matches, updating tests to reflect the new default-disabled semantics.
  • Add alwaysOnToolIds (lobe-tools, lobe-skills) to the builtin tools package for core system tools that should always be enabled.
  • Extend agent and server-side tools engine creation to include user-selected plugins and always-on builtin tools in the rules map, alongside system-level rules like knowledge base, memory, web browsing, and local system availability.
  • Add a ToolsEngine test covering explicit activation behavior when only the notebook plugin is selected, validating inclusion of notebook, web browsing, and always-on built-ins but excluding non-selected, non-always-on tools.
| `packages/context-engine/src/engine/tools/enableCheckerFactory.ts`

`src/helpers/toolEngineering/index.ts`
`src/helpers/toolEngineering/index.test.ts`
`src/server/modules/Mecha/AgentToolsEngine/index.ts` | | Refine chat input loading/disabled behavior so it covers sendMessage as well as AI runtime operations, and ensure cancelling generation restores editor state. |
  • Define INPUT_LOADING_OPERATION_TYPES as a superset of AI_RUNTIME_OPERATION_TYPES that also includes sendMessage to represent all operations that should block the input.
  • Add isInputLoadingByContext selector that filters operations by context and thread, and returns true when any input-blocking operation is running and not aborting, wiring it into the exported operationSelectors.
  • Expose isInputLoading on the conversation message state, extend OperationState and DEFAULT_OPERATION_STATE to carry this flag, and read it via useOperationState using the new isInputLoadingByContext selector.
  • Update ChatInput to drive disabled/generating state from isInputLoading instead of isAIGenerating, and to guard handleSend against both file uploads and the broader input-loading state.
  • Change the generation stop action to cancel all input-blocking operations (including sendMessage and agent mode stream) and call cancelSendMessageInServer to restore editor content when sendMessage is cancelled.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adds routing and settings support for the desktop "Advanced" mode, including wiring the Advanced tab into the settings component map and introducing a new agent channel route under the desktop chat layout. #### Flow diagram for updated desktop agent routing with channel route ```mermaid flowchart TD DesktopRoot["Desktop routes"] DesktopRoot --> AgentRoot["Route path 'agent/:agentId'"] AgentRoot --> DesktopChatLayout["Element DesktopChatLayout"] DesktopChatLayout --> AgentHomePage["Default child route AgentHomePage"] DesktopChatLayout --> AgentCronDetailPage["Route path 'cron/:cronId' AgentCronDetailPage"] DesktopChatLayout --> AgentChannelPage["Route path 'channel' AgentChannelPage"] ``` #### Flow diagram for desktop settings component map including Advanced tab ```mermaid flowchart LR SettingsTabs["SettingsTabs enum"] ComponentMap["componentMap object"] SettingsTabs -->|Advanced| AdvancedTab["SettingsTabs.Advanced"] SettingsTabs -->|Beta| BetaTab["SettingsTabs.Beta"] SettingsTabs -->|Common| CommonTab["SettingsTabs.Common"] SettingsTabs -->|ChatAppearance| ChatAppearanceTab["SettingsTabs.ChatAppearance"] AdvancedTab -->|maps_to| AdvancedComponent["Advanced component"] BetaTab -->|maps_to| BetaComponent["Beta component"] CommonTab -->|maps_to| CommonComponent["Common component"] ChatAppearanceTab -->|maps_to| ChatAppearanceComponent["ChatAppearance component"] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Extend desktop agent routing to include an agent channel page under the main agent layout. |
  • Add a new child route with path 'channel' under the agent routes hierarchy.
  • Render the AgentChannelPage component for the new 'channel' route within DesktopChatLayout.
  • Ensure the new route participates in the existing error boundary setup for agent routes.
| `src/spa/router/desktopRouter.config.desktop.tsx` | | Wire the Advanced settings tab to its corresponding component in the desktop settings feature map so the Advanced tab works in desktop mode. |
  • Map SettingsTabs.Advanced to the Advanced component in the desktop settings component map.
  • Align desktop settings tab handling with other existing tabs (Beta, Common, ChatAppearance, etc.).
| `src/routes/(main)/settings/features/componentMap.desktop.ts` |
---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

body:
## Reviewer's Guide Implements an OpenResponses-compliant Response API on top of the existing AiAgent/AgentRuntime pipeline, including sync and streaming execution, topic-linked response IDs, and support for additional system instructions, plus wiring into the OpenAPI routes and adding a compliance test harness. #### Sequence diagram for streaming Response API flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Client participant HonoRouter as HonoRouter_responses participant ResponsesController participant ResponsesService participant AiAgentService participant AgentRuntimeService participant InMemoryStreamEventManager Client->>HonoRouter: POST /api/v1/responses { stream: true } HonoRouter->>ResponsesController: createResponse(c) ResponsesController->>ResponsesController: getBody ResponsesController->>ResponsesController: getUserId ResponsesController->>ResponsesController: getDatabase ResponsesController->>ResponsesService: new ResponsesService(db, userId) alt streaming request ResponsesController->>ResponsesController: handleStreamingResponse(c, service, params) ResponsesController-->>Client: streamSSE loop SSE event loop Client-->>ResponsesService: createStreamingResponse(params) activate ResponsesService note over ResponsesService: Extract prompt and instructions ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: extractPrompt(input) ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: buildInstructions(params) note over ResponsesService,AiAgentService: Create agent operation with streaming enabled ResponsesService->>AiAgentService: execAgent(appContext, autoStart=false, instructions, prompt, slug, stream=true) AiAgentService-->>ResponsesService: { success, operationId, topicId } ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: generateResponseId(topicId) ResponsesService-->>Client: response.created SSE ResponsesService-->>Client: response.in_progress SSE note over ResponsesService,AgentRuntimeService: Setup streaming bridge ResponsesService->>InMemoryStreamEventManager: new InMemoryStreamEventManager ResponsesService->>AgentRuntimeService: new AgentRuntimeService(db, userId, streamEventManager) ResponsesService->>InMemoryStreamEventManager: subscribe(operationId, callback) par execute agent in background ResponsesService->>AgentRuntimeService: executeSync(operationId) AgentRuntimeService-->>InMemoryStreamEventManager: streamChunk events and consume events loop while events available InMemoryStreamEventManager-->>ResponsesService: StreamEvent batch ResponsesService-->>Client: response.output_item.added SSE ResponsesService-->>Client: response.content_part.added SSE ResponsesService-->>Client: response.output_text.delta SSE end end ResponsesService->>InMemoryStreamEventManager: unsubscribe(operationId) ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: extractOutputItems(finalState, responseId) ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: extractUsage(finalState) ResponsesService-->>Client: response.output_text.done SSE ResponsesService-->>Client: response.content_part.done SSE ResponsesService-->>Client: response.output_item.done SSE ResponsesService-->>Client: response.completed SSE deactivate ResponsesService end else non streaming request ResponsesController->>ResponsesService: createResponse(params) activate ResponsesService ResponsesService->>AiAgentService: execAgent(appContext, autoStart=false, instructions, prompt, slug, stream=false) AiAgentService-->>ResponsesService: { success, operationId, topicId } ResponsesService->>AgentRuntimeService: executeSync(operationId) AgentRuntimeService-->>ResponsesService: final AgentState ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: extractOutputItems(state, responseId) ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: extractUsage(state) ResponsesService->>ResponsesService: buildResponseObject(...) ResponsesService-->>ResponsesController: ResponseObject deactivate ResponsesService ResponsesController-->>Client: JSON ResponseObject end ``` #### Class diagram for ResponsesService and related types ```mermaid classDiagram class BaseService { <> - db - userId + log(level, message, metadata) } class ResponsesService { +ResponsesService(db, userId) -extractPrompt(input) -extractInputInstructions(input) -buildInstructions(params) -extractAssistantContent(state) -extractOutputItems(state, responseId) -extractUsage(state) +createResponse(params) +createStreamingResponse(params) -generateResponseId(topicId) -extractTopicIdFromResponseId(responseId) -buildResponseObject(options) } class AiAgentService { +execAgent(params) } class AgentRuntimeService { +AgentRuntimeService(db, userId, options) +executeSync(operationId) } class InMemoryStreamEventManager { +subscribe(operationId, callback) +unsubscribe(operationId) } class ResponsesController { +createResponse(c) -handleStreamingResponse(c, service, params) } class CreateResponseRequest { +input +instructions +max_output_tokens +metadata +model +parallel_tool_calls +previous_response_id +reasoning +stream +temperature +tool_choice +tools +top_p +truncation +user } class ResponseObject { +background +completed_at +created_at +error +frequency_penalty +id +incomplete_details +instructions +max_output_tokens +metadata +model +object +output +output_text +parallel_tool_calls +presence_penalty +previous_response_id +reasoning +service_tier +status +store +temperature +text +tool_choice +tools +top_p +truncation +usage +user } class OutputItem { <> } class ResponseUsage { +input_tokens +output_tokens +total_tokens } class ExecAgentParams { +appContext +autoStart +existingMessageIds +instructions +prompt +slug +stream } BaseService <|-- ResponsesService BaseService <|-- ResponsesController ResponsesController --> ResponsesService : uses ResponsesService --> AiAgentService : delegates execAgent ResponsesService --> AgentRuntimeService : uses for executeSync ResponsesService --> InMemoryStreamEventManager : uses for streaming ResponsesService --> CreateResponseRequest : input ResponsesService --> ResponseObject : output ResponsesService --> OutputItem : builds ResponsesService --> ResponseUsage : builds AiAgentService --> ExecAgentParams : input ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Allow execAgent callers to pass additional system instructions that are appended to an agent’s system role. |
  • Extend ExecAgentParams with an optional instructions field used to carry extra system prompt text.
  • Thread the instructions parameter into AiAgentService.execAgent and append it to agentConfig.systemRole when present, logging the behavior.
| `src/server/services/aiAgent/index.ts`
`packages/types/src/agentGroup/index.ts` | | Introduce a full OpenResponses-compatible Response API service with sync and streaming support backed by AiAgentService and AgentRuntimeService. |
  • Implement ResponsesService with helpers to parse OpenResponses input items into prompt/instructions, map AgentState messages into Response API output items (including tool calls), compute usage, and build ResponseObject payloads.
  • Add createResponse for non-streaming execution using execAgent(autoStart:false) plus executeSync, and createStreamingResponse as an async generator that bridges AgentRuntime stream events to OpenResponses SSE events with proper lifecycle events and IDs.
  • Encode topicId into response IDs for multi-turn support and provide utilities to extract topicId from previous_response_id.
| `packages/openapi/src/services/responses.service.ts` | | Define OpenResponses request/response schemas and streaming event types with Zod and TypeScript. |
  • Add Zod schemas for content parts, input/output items, tools, truncation, reasoning, and CreateResponseRequest validation.
  • Define ResponseObject, ResponseUsage, error types, and a comprehensive union of ResponseStreamEvent variants for SSE streaming.
  • Expose these types through the OpenAPI types barrel export.
| `packages/openapi/src/types/responses.type.ts`
`packages/openapi/src/types/index.ts` | | Expose the new Response API endpoint through the OpenAPI HTTP surface with validation and auth. |
  • Create ResponsesController that dispatches to ResponsesService, handling both JSON and SSE streaming responses using hono’s streamSSE.
  • Register /responses POST route in Hono with auth middleware and request body validation, and wire the route into the main routes index.
| `packages/openapi/src/controllers/responses.controller.ts`
`packages/openapi/src/routes/responses.route.ts`
`packages/openapi/src/routes/index.ts` | | Add an OpenResponses compliance test harness and skill documentation for running the official test suite. |
  • Add a Bun-based shell script that clones/updates the openresponses repo, installs dependencies, derives base URL and API key from env, and runs the upstream compliance-test CLI with forwarded flags.
  • Expose a package.json script to invoke the compliance test runner and document usage, auth modes, and key test IDs in a new response-compliance skill markdown.
  • Ignore transient artifacts under the scripts directory via a .gitignore.
| `packages/openapi/package.json`
`.agents/skills/response-compliance/SKILL.md`
`packages/openapi/scripts/compliance-test.sh`
`packages/openapi/scripts/.gitignore` | ---

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Updates the fork upstream sync GitHub Actions workflow to use non-persisted checkout credentials, optionally use a PAT for syncing workflow changes, and conditionally run issue-helper steps only when issues are enabled on the repository. #### Sequence diagram for updated fork upstream sync workflow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Developer participant GitHubActions as GitHub_Actions_Workflow participant Runner as Actions_Runner participant ForkRepo as Fork_Repository participant UpstreamRepo as Upstream_Repository participant PAT as UPSTREAM_SYNC_TOKEN participant GHToken as GITHUB_TOKEN participant IssuesHelper as issues_helper_action participant GitHubAPI as GitHub_API Developer->>GitHubActions: Triggers sync workflow GitHubActions->>Runner: Start job sync Note over Runner,ForkRepo: Checkout repository with persist-credentials false Runner->>ForkRepo: git fetch/checkout (no persisted credentials) alt repository has_issues is true Runner->>IssuesHelper: Clean issue notice (close-issues) IssuesHelper->>GitHubAPI: Close existing sync issues else repository has_issues is false Runner-->>IssuesHelper: Skip issue cleanup step end Note over Runner,PAT: Determine token for upstream sync alt UPSTREAM_SYNC_TOKEN is set Runner->>PAT: Use PAT for upstream sync (workflow scope) else UPSTREAM_SYNC_TOKEN is not set Runner->>GHToken: Use default GITHUB_TOKEN for sync end Runner->>UpstreamRepo: Fetch upstream branch main Runner->>ForkRepo: Push synced changes to main using selected token alt sync job fails and repository has_issues is true Runner->>IssuesHelper: Sync check (create-issue) IssuesHelper->>GitHubAPI: Create failure notification issue else no failure or repository has_issues is false Runner-->>IssuesHelper: Skip issue creation step end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Harden and fix the fork upstream sync GitHub Actions workflow behavior for credentials and issue handling. |
  • Disable checkout credential persistence so that subsequent Git operations use explicitly configured tokens instead of the default GITHUB_TOKEN.
  • Add support for an optional UPSTREAM_SYNC_TOKEN secret, falling back to GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling pushes to workflow files that require a PAT with workflow scope.
  • Guard the issue-closing step with a condition that checks that repository issues are enabled.
  • Update the sync failure issue-creation step to only run when the job has failed and the repository has issues enabled.
